-- The WHIP layer, client side (server.lua decides it). Says in F8 what the server decided and what whip_core's page
-- was last told, once the player is in; and if the server holds the layer but this page never got it (a broadcast
-- missed while loading), hands whip_core its own applyTheme event again, locally.

local SELF = GetCurrentResourceName()
local pageTheme = nil   -- the last theme whip_core's page was told to load (its applyTheme event), if any

RegisterNetEvent('whip_core:client:applyTheme')
AddEventHandler('whip_core:client:applyTheme', function(resource) pageTheme = resource or false end)

local function check()
    local layer = GlobalState.d11_hud_layer
    if type(layer) ~= 'table' then
        print('^3[d11_hud] WHIP layer: no word from d11_hud\'s server side (is server.lua running? check the server console)^0')
        return
    end
    print(('%s[d11_hud] %s^0'):format(layer.on and '^2' or '^3', tostring(layer.text)))
    -- The theme that carries the layer: d11_hud itself, or d11_theme (1.0.4 sent d11_hud over d11_theme here).
    local theme = layer.theme or SELF
    if layer.on and pageTheme ~= theme then
        print(('^3[d11_hud] whip_core\'s page had not been sent the theme %s: sending it again^0'):format(theme))
        TriggerEvent('whip_core:client:applyTheme', theme)
    end
end

AddEventHandler('whip_core:player:loaded', function() SetTimeout(5000, check) end)
-- d11_hud (re)started with the player already in
CreateThread(function()
    Wait(5000)
    if Hud.core('IsPlayerLoaded') == true then check() end
end)

-- Clothing as items, client side: game number <-> collection + local index, dressing the ped, saving the look.
--
-- A piece keeps the COLLECTION and the number inside it ({ t = 'c'|'p', s = slot, col, i, tex }), not the global
-- number: that one moves when a clothing pack starts before another or the game build changes. 'base' = the base
-- game, where the local number is the global one (as in whip_core/client/appearance.lua).

local MODEL = { [joaat('mp_m_freemode_01')] = 'male', [joaat('mp_f_freemode_01')] = 'female' }

local function genderOf(ped) return MODEL[GetEntityModel(ped)] end

local function copy(t) return json.decode(json.encode(t)) end

--- Game number -> part. nil when the game cannot tell.
local function partOf(ped, t, s, d, tex)
    local name, idx
    if t == 'c' then
        name, idx = GetPedCollectionNameFromDrawable(ped, s, d), GetPedCollectionLocalIndexFromDrawable(ped, s, d)
    else
        name, idx = GetPedCollectionNameFromProp(ped, s, d), GetPedCollectionLocalIndexFromProp(ped, s, d)
    end
    if type(name) ~= 'string' or type(idx) ~= 'number' or idx < 0 then return nil end
    if name == '' or name == GetPedCollectionName(ped, 0) then name = 'base' end
    return { t = t, s = s, col = name, i = idx, tex = math.max(0, tex or 0) }
end

--- Part -> game number, or -1 when its collection is not loaded.
local function globalOf(ped, p)
    if p.col == 'base' then return p.i end
    local d
    if p.t == 'c' then d = GetPedDrawableGlobalIndexFromCollection(ped, p.s, p.col, p.i)
    else d = GetPedPropGlobalIndexFromCollection(ped, p.s, p.col, p.i) end
    return type(d) == 'number' and d or -1
end

--- The game number of a component's "undressed".
local function undressedOf(ped, gender, s)
    local item = Config.Undressed[gender][s]
    if not item then return 0 end
    return globalOf(ped, { t = 'c', s = s, col = item[1], i = item[2] })
end

-- ============================================
-- Gloves: an "arm" (component 3) with a gloved hand (data/gloves-<body>.json)
-- ============================================
-- GTA has no glove slot: a glove is an arm with the hand covered. For each base-game arm the data says its type (the
-- bare arm of the same shape), whether it is a glove and which glove (the style: the same glove on every type). The
-- Shirt keeps the bare arm of its type; the Gloves item keeps the glove, worn on the shirt's arm type. An arm the
-- data does not know (a clothing pack's) stays with the Shirt.

local glovesCache = {}   -- [gender] = data or false
local function glovesOf(gender)
    if glovesCache[gender] ~= nil then return glovesCache[gender] or nil end
    local raw = LoadResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), ('data/gloves-%s.json'):format(gender))
    local ok, d = pcall(json.decode, raw or '')
    glovesCache[gender] = ok and type(d) == 'table' and d or false
    return glovesCache[gender] or nil
end

local armMaps = {}   -- [gender] = { byKey = { ['male_heist_011'] = 74 }, byD = { [74] = 'male_heist_011' } }
local function armMap(ped, gender)
    if armMaps[gender] then return armMaps[gender] end
    local m = { byKey = {}, byD = {} }
    for d = 0, GetNumberOfPedDrawableVariations(ped, 3) - 1 do
        local p = partOf(ped, 'c', 3, d, 0)
        if p then
            local k = ('%s_%03d'):format(p.col:lower(), p.i)
            m.byKey[k], m.byD[d] = d, k
        end
    end
    armMaps[gender] = m
    return m
end

--- What an arm is: { type, glove, style } (type = the bare arm's key), or nil when the data does not know it.
local function armInfo(ped, gender, d)
    local data = glovesOf(gender)
    if not data or type(d) ~= 'number' or d < 0 then return nil end
    local k = armMap(ped, gender).byD[d]
    if not k then return nil end
    if data.types and data.types[k] then return { type = k, glove = false } end
    local a = data.arms and data.arms[k]
    if not a then return nil end
    return { type = a.type, glove = a.glove == true, style = a.style }
end

--- The game arm of type `armType` wearing glove `style` (nil = bare), or -1.
local function armOf(ped, gender, armType, style)
    local data = glovesOf(gender)
    if not data or not armType then return -1 end
    local k = armType
    if style ~= nil then k = ((data.styles or {})[tostring(style)] or {})[armType] end
    return k and armMap(ped, gender).byKey[k] or -1
end

--- What a saved look wears in a category: { parts, piece, tex } or false (nothing past "undressed").
local function pieceOfLook(ped, gender, app, cat)
    local parts, dressed = {}, false
    for _, s in ipairs(cat.c or {}) do
        local c = (app.components or {})[tostring(s)] or {}
        local d = tonumber(c.drawable) or 0
        local tex = tonumber(c.texture)
        if s == 3 then
            -- A gloved arm becomes the Gloves item; the Shirt keeps the bare arm of the same type.
            local info = armInfo(ped, gender, d)
            if cat.gloves then
                if not (info and info.glove) then return false end
                dressed = true
            elseif info and info.glove and info.type then
                local bare = armOf(ped, gender, info.type, nil)
                if bare >= 0 then d, tex = bare, 0 end
            end
        end
        if not cat.gloves and d ~= undressedOf(ped, gender, s) then dressed = true end
        local p = partOf(ped, 'c', s, d, tex)
        if not p then return false end
        parts[#parts + 1] = p
    end
    for _, s in ipairs(cat.p or {}) do
        local pr = (app.props or {})[tostring(s)] or {}
        local d = tonumber(pr.drawable) or -1
        if d < 0 then return false end
        local p = partOf(ped, 'p', s, d, tonumber(pr.texture))
        if not p then return false end
        parts[#parts + 1] = p
        dressed = true
    end
    if not dressed then return false end
    local p = parts[1]
    local piece = p.col == 'base' and (L('Base game %d', 'Jogo base %d')):format(p.i) or ('%s %d'):format(p.col, p.i)
    return { parts = parts, piece = piece, tex = p.tex }
end

local function piecesOfLook(ped, gender, app)
    local out = {}
    for _, cat in ipairs(Config.Categories) do out[cat.key] = pieceOfLook(ped, gender, app, cat) end
    return out
end

--- A look's clothes as comparable text (components 1 and 3-11, props).
local function clothesOf(app)
    local out = {}
    for s = 1, 11 do
        if s ~= 2 then
            local c = (app.components or {})[tostring(s)] or {}
            out[#out + 1] = ('%s:%s'):format(c.drawable, c.texture)
        end
    end
    for _, s in ipairs({ 0, 1, 2, 6, 7 }) do
        local p = (app.props or {})[tostring(s)] or {}
        out[#out + 1] = ('%s:%s'):format(p.drawable, p.texture)
    end
    return table.concat(out, ',')
end

-- ============================================
-- The look: the saved one, with what we are about to save on top
-- ============================================

local look = nil          -- the last look we know (the saved one, or the one we sent to save)
local sent = nil          -- clothesOf() of the last one we sent to save
local lastSave = 0
local saveQueued = false

local function currentLook()
    if look then return look end
    local pd = exports.whip_core:GetPlayer() or {}
    local app = pd.metadata and pd.metadata.appearance
    return type(app) == 'table' and app.model and copy(app) or nil
end

-- WHIP takes one save every 2 s (saveAppearance's rateLimit): several quick changes become one.
local function saveSoon()
    if saveQueued then return end
    saveQueued = true
    CreateThread(function()
        local wait = 2100 - (GetGameTimer() - lastSave)
        if wait > 0 then Wait(wait) end
        saveQueued = false
        if not look then return end
        sent = clothesOf(look)
        lastSave = GetGameTimer()
        TriggerServerEvent('whip_core:server:saveAppearance', look)
    end)
end

-- ============================================
-- Dressing (the strip changed, or the login)
-- ============================================

--- `changed[cat]` = list of parts, or false (take off). Only those categories are dressed: a uniform put on by
--- another script (a job locker) stays in the others.
RegisterNetEvent('d11_clothing:dress', function(changed)
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    local gender = genderOf(ped)
    local app = currentLook()
    if not gender or not app or type(changed) ~= 'table' then return end
    app.components, app.props = app.components or {}, app.props or {}
    local before = clothesOf(app)
    -- The arm on the body now: the shirt's (bare) arm, and the glove over it, if any.
    local armNow = app.components['3'] or {}
    local ad, atex = tonumber(armNow.drawable) or undressedOf(ped, gender, 3), tonumber(armNow.texture) or 0
    local glove = nil   -- { d, tex }
    local info = armInfo(ped, gender, ad)
    if info and info.glove then
        glove = { d = ad, tex = atex }
        local bare = armOf(ped, gender, info.type, nil)
        ad, atex = bare >= 0 and bare or undressedOf(ped, gender, 3), 0
    end
    local armTouched = false
    for _, cat in ipairs(Config.Categories) do
        local parts = changed[cat.key]
        if parts ~= nil then
            local bySlot = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(parts or {}) do bySlot[p.t .. p.s] = p end
            for _, s in ipairs(cat.c or {}) do
                local p = bySlot['c' .. s]
                local d, tex = p and globalOf(ped, p) or undressedOf(ped, gender, s), p and p.tex or 0
                if d < 0 then d, tex = undressedOf(ped, gender, s), 0 end   -- the piece's pack is not running
                if s == 3 then
                    armTouched = true
                    if cat.gloves then
                        glove = p and { d = d, tex = tex } or nil
                    else
                        ad, atex = d, tex
                        local i2 = armInfo(ped, gender, d)   -- an older shirt with the glove inside
                        if i2 and i2.glove then
                            if not glove then glove = { d = d, tex = tex } end
                            local bare = armOf(ped, gender, i2.type, nil)
                            ad, atex = bare >= 0 and bare or undressedOf(ped, gender, 3), 0
                        end
                    end
                else
                    SetPedComponentVariation(ped, s, d, tex, 0)
                    app.components[tostring(s)] = { drawable = d, texture = tex }
                end
            end
            for _, s in ipairs(cat.p or {}) do
                local p = bySlot['p' .. s]
                local d = p and globalOf(ped, p) or -1
                if d < 0 then
                    ClearPedProp(ped, s)
                    app.props[tostring(s)] = { drawable = -1, texture = 0 }
                else
                    SetPedPropIndex(ped, s, d, p.tex, true)
                    app.props[tostring(s)] = { drawable = d, texture = p.tex }
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if armTouched then
        local d, tex = ad, atex
        if glove and glove.d >= 0 then
            local baseType = (armInfo(ped, gender, ad) or {}).type
            local gi = armInfo(ped, gender, glove.d)
            local gd = (gi and gi.style ~= nil and baseType) and armOf(ped, gender, baseType, gi.style) or -1
            if gd >= 0 then d, tex = gd, glove.tex
            elseif gi and gi.type == baseType then d, tex = glove.d, glove.tex end
            -- Else this glove has no version for these arms (long sleeves, one-piece arms): bare hands.
        end
        SetPedComponentVariation(ped, 3, d, tex, 0)
        app.components['3'] = { drawable = d, texture = tex }
    end
    look = app
    if clothesOf(app) ~= before then saveSoon() end
end)

-- The look was saved (WHIP's editor, a store, or us): if it was not us, the editor's clothes become items.
RegisterNetEvent('d11_clothing:check', function(app)
    if type(app) ~= 'table' or not app.model then return end
    local clothes = clothesOf(app)
    if clothes == sent then return end
    look = copy(app)
    sent = clothes
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    local gender = genderOf(ped)
    if not gender or GetEntityModel(ped) ~= joaat(app.model) then return end
    TriggerServerEvent('d11_clothing:editor', gender, piecesOfLook(ped, gender, app))
end)

-- ============================================
-- Login
-- ============================================

local function announce()
    CreateThread(function()
        local ped = PlayerPedId()
        local gender = genderOf(ped)
        look, sent = nil, nil
        local app = currentLook()
        if not gender or not app then return end
        TriggerServerEvent('d11_clothing:ready', gender, piecesOfLook(ped, gender, app))
    end)
end

AddEventHandler('whip_core:player:loaded', announce)
AddEventHandler('whip_core:player:logout', function() look, sent = nil, nil end)

-- This resource restarted with the character in game.
AddEventHandler('onClientResourceStart', function(res)
    if res ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then return end
    local pd = exports.whip_core:GetPlayer() or {}
    if pd.charId then announce() end
end)

--[[
    server/custom.lua

    Adding and aligning equipment from inside the game, with no file to edit and no restart.

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    THE WHOLE FLOW, FOR A GYM MLO NOBODY HAS EVER SEEN
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        walk up to the treadmill
        /vsportadd treadmill                 <- no model name to type; it uses what you face
        /vsportprop treadmill                <- align the body in the studio
        press ENTER                          <- saved, live, for everyone

    That is it. No config.lua, no restart, no copying blocks out of F8. When it is proven,
    /vsportexport prints the same thing as a config.lua block so it can graduate into version
    control.

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    WHO IS TRUSTED WITH WHAT
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    The CLIENT decides which prop the admin is looking at, because only the client can see the
    object pool, and validates the model with IsModelValid so a typo cannot be written into a file
    that is read at every boot from now on.

    The SERVER decides whether that player may change anything, and it re-checks Bridge.isAdmin on
    every event rather than trusting the gate the client was given. It also re-validates the model
    NAME, because a client can send whatever it likes and this one ends up on disk.

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    WHAT IT COSTS
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Nothing at steady state. The file is read once at boot and written only when something changes,
    debounced so that holding a tuner key does not write a file per frame. The overlay is pushed to
    a client once when it joins and once per change - a handful of small events over a session.
]]

Custom.store = {}               -- key -> entry, in STORAGE shape (plain tables, not vector3)

local FILE = 'data/custom.json'
local dirty = false
local writeAt = nil             -- game time to flush at, for the debounce

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Disk
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--[[
    Read the overlay off disk.

    Every failure here is survivable and none of them may take the resource down: a missing file is
    the normal first boot, and a corrupt one is somebody's half-finished hand edit. Both end with an
    empty overlay and a warning, because the alternative - a resource that refuses to start because
    of a stray comma in an optional file - is worse than losing the additions.
]]
local function readFile()
    local raw = LoadResourceFile(Sport.resource, FILE)

    if not raw or raw == '' then
        Sport.debug('no ' .. FILE .. ' yet, starting with no custom equipment')
        return {}
    end

    local ok, decoded = pcall(json.decode, raw)
    if not ok or type(decoded) ~= 'table' then
        Sport.warn(FILE .. ' could not be parsed and was ignored. Fix or delete it; '
            .. 'nothing has been overwritten.')
        return {}
    end

    -- A version field so a future format change can migrate rather than guess.
    local entries = type(decoded.equipment) == 'table' and decoded.equipment or {}

    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(entries) do count = count + 1 end
    Sport.print(('loaded %d custom equipment entr%s from %s')
        :format(count, count == 1 and 'y' or 'ies', FILE))

    return entries
end

--- Write the overlay to disk. Called from the debounce, never directly from a command.
local function writeFile()
    local payload = json.encode({
        version = 1,
        note = 'Managed by v-sport. Written by /vsportadd, /vsportremove and the tuner. '
            .. 'Safe to delete: you lose the additions, nothing else. '
            .. 'Use /vsportexport to move them into config.lua permanently.',
        equipment = Custom.store,
    })

    if SaveResourceFile(Sport.resource, FILE, payload, -1) then
        Sport.debug('wrote ' .. FILE)
        return true
    end

    Sport.warn('could not write ' .. FILE .. ' - is the resource folder read-only? '
        .. 'The change is live but will be lost on restart. Use /vsportexport to keep it.')
    return false
end

--[[
    Mark the overlay changed, and flush shortly.

    Debounced because the tuner can save on a key repeat: without this, holding an arrow key while
    aligned to a prop would write the same file dozens of times a second. Two seconds is long enough
    to coalesce a burst and short enough that nobody who types /vsportadd and immediately restarts
    loses the change.
]]
local function touch()
    dirty = true
    writeAt = GetGameTimer() + 2000
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(500)
        if dirty and writeAt and GetGameTimer() >= writeAt then
            dirty = false
            writeAt = nil
            writeFile()
        end
    end
end)

-- Never lose a pending write because somebody restarted the resource two seconds too early.
AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= Sport.resource then return end
    if dirty then writeFile() end
end)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Applying and broadcasting
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- Rebuild the server's own catalogue from the overlay, and push it to clients.
--- `target` pushes to one player - for a join - and nil broadcasts to everyone.
function Custom.apply(target)
    Equipment.overlay = Custom.unpackAll(Custom.store)
    Equipment.build()

    -- The clients get the STORAGE shape and unpack it themselves, so the vector3 conversion
    -- happens on exactly one side of the wire and cannot disagree with itself.
    TriggerClientEvent('vsport:client:CustomEquipment', target or -1, Custom.store)
end

CreateThread(function()
    -- After the catalogue's own build at the bottom of shared/equipment.lua.
    Wait(0)
    Custom.store = readFile()
    Equipment.overlay = Custom.unpackAll(Custom.store)
    Equipment.build()
end)

AddEventHandler('vsport:server:PlayerLoaded', function(src)
    if next(Custom.store) == nil then return end
    TriggerClientEvent('vsport:client:CustomEquipment', src, Custom.store)
end)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Changes, all of them from a client and all of them re-authorised here
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- Refuse anything from a player the server does not consider staff. Returns true when allowed.
local function authorised(src, what)
    if Config.Commands.restrictDevCommands == false then return true end
    if Bridge.isAdmin(src) then return true end

    Sport.warn(('%s (%s) tried to %s without permission'):format(
        GetPlayerName(src) or '?', tostring(src), what))
    Bridge.notify(src, L('notify.no_permission'), 'error')
    return false
end

--- The stored entry for `key`, created empty if it does not exist yet.
local function entryFor(key)
    local entry = Custom.store[key]
    if not entry then
        entry = {}
        Custom.store[key] = entry
    end
    return entry
end

--[[
    Add a model to an exercise.

    The model joins the SHIPPED list rather than replacing it, which is the behaviour an operator
    expects from "add" and is not what Sport.merge does on its own - it replaces a list wholesale.
    So the stored list is the shipped models plus the additions, rebuilt each time.
]]
RegisterNetEvent('vsport:server:CustomAdd', function(key, model)
    local src = source
    if not authorised(src, 'add equipment') then return end

    if type(key) ~= 'string' or not Custom.validModelName(model) then
        Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.bad_input'), 'error')
        return
    end

    -- The exercise has to exist. Creating one from a chat command would need gains, reps, a
    -- difficulty and an animation, none of which a command line is a good place for - config.lua
    -- is, and PROPS.md documents it.
    local shipped = Equipment.shipped and Equipment.shipped[key]
    if type(shipped) ~= 'table' then
        Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.no_exercise', key), 'error')
        return
    end

    local entry = entryFor(key)

    --[[
        SEED FROM WHAT IS STORED, NOT FROM WHAT SHIPS, once anything has been stored.

        Merging the shipped list in on every add UNDID every removal: /vsportremove wrote a shorter
        list, and the next /vsportadd on the same exercise rebuilt it from the shipped models and
        brought the removed one back. Two commands, opposite intents, and the second silently won.

        A stored list is the operator's current answer for this exercise. Shipped models are only the
        starting point for an entry nobody has touched yet.
    ]]
    local base = (type(entry.models) == 'table' and #entry.models > 0)
        and entry.models
        or (shipped.models or {})

    local models, seen = {}, {}
    for _, name in ipairs(base) do
        if type(name) == 'string' and not seen[name] then
            seen[name] = true
            models[#models + 1] = name
        end
    end

    if seen[model] then
        Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.already', model, key), 'error')
        return
    end

    models[#models + 1] = model
    entry.models = models

    -- An MLO-only exercise stops being MLO-only the moment it has a model.
    if shipped.mloOnly then entry.mloOnly = false end

    -- And a disabled one is presumably being added to because somebody wants it back.
    if shipped.enabled == false then entry.enabled = true end

    touch()
    Custom.apply()

    Sport.print(('%s added %s to %s'):format(GetPlayerName(src) or src, model, key))
    Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.added', model, key), 'success')
end)

--- Remove a model that was added. Shipped models can be removed too - a bench that your MLO
--- replaced with its own geometry is a real case - and the removal is remembered.
RegisterNetEvent('vsport:server:CustomRemove', function(key, model)
    local src = source
    if not authorised(src, 'remove equipment') then return end

    if type(key) ~= 'string' or not Custom.validModelName(model) then
        Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.bad_input'), 'error')
        return
    end

    local shipped = Equipment.shipped and Equipment.shipped[key]
    if type(shipped) ~= 'table' then
        Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.no_exercise', key), 'error')
        return
    end

    local entry = entryFor(key)
    local current = entry.models or shipped.models or {}

    local kept, removed = {}, false
    for _, name in ipairs(current) do
        if name == model then
            removed = true
        else
            kept[#kept + 1] = name
        end
    end

    if not removed then
        Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.not_listed', model, key), 'error')
        return
    end

    entry.models = kept

    touch()
    Custom.apply()

    Sport.print(('%s removed %s from %s'):format(GetPlayerName(src) or src, model, key))
    Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.removed', model, key), 'success')
end)

--[[
    Save an alignment from the tuner.

    `payload` is one model's placement: animOffset, animHeading, animRot and the held props, in
    STORAGE shape. It is written as a modelOverrides entry rather than onto the exercise itself,
    which is what makes it safe - aligning one bench cannot move the body on the other five.
]]
RegisterNetEvent('vsport:server:CustomAlign', function(key, model, payload)
    local src = source
    if not authorised(src, 'save an alignment') then return end

    if type(key) ~= 'string' or not Custom.validModelName(model)
        or type(payload) ~= 'table' then
        Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.bad_input'), 'error')
        return
    end

    local shipped = Equipment.shipped and Equipment.shipped[key]
    if type(shipped) ~= 'table' then
        Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.no_exercise', key), 'error')
        return
    end

    local entry = entryFor(key)
    entry.modelOverrides = type(entry.modelOverrides) == 'table' and entry.modelOverrides or {}

    -- Only the fields a placement consists of. Anything else the client sent is discarded rather
    -- than merged, so a modified client cannot write arbitrary keys into an equipment entry.
    local clean = {
        placeAnim = true,
        animOffset = payload.animOffset,
        animHeading = tonumber(payload.animHeading),
        animRot = payload.animRot,
        props = payload.props,
    }

    entry.modelOverrides[model] = Custom.pack(clean)

    -- A placement is meaningless unless the exercise places its animation at all.
    entry.placeAnim = true

    touch()
    Custom.apply()

    Sport.print(('%s saved an alignment for %s on %s')
        :format(GetPlayerName(src) or src, model, key))
    Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.aligned', model, key), 'success')
end)

--- Forget everything stored for one exercise, or all of it.
RegisterNetEvent('vsport:server:CustomReset', function(key)
    local src = source
    if not authorised(src, 'reset custom equipment') then return end

    if key == nil or key == '' or key == 'all' then
        Custom.store = {}
        Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.reset_all'), 'success')
    elseif type(key) == 'string' and Custom.store[key] then
        Custom.store[key] = nil
        Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.reset_one', key), 'success')
    else
        Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.nothing_stored'), 'error')
        return
    end

    touch()
    Custom.apply()
end)

--- Re-read the file, for someone who edited it by hand or restored a backup.
RegisterNetEvent('vsport:server:CustomReload', function()
    local src = source
    if not authorised(src, 'reload custom equipment') then return end

    Custom.store = readFile()
    Custom.apply()

    Bridge.notify(src, L('custom.reloaded'), 'success')
end)

--[[
    Print the overlay as a config.lua block, to whoever asked and to the server console.

    THE POINT OF THIS COMMAND IS GRADUATION. data/custom.json is convenient and it is not version
    control: it is one deleted folder away from gone, and it does not travel with an update. An
    addition proven in game belongs in config.lua, and this is what makes moving it a paste.
]]
RegisterNetEvent('vsport:server:CustomExport', function()
    local src = source
    if not authorised(src, 'export custom equipment') then return end

    local lines = {}
    local function say(text) lines[#lines + 1] = text end

    if next(Custom.store) == nil then
        say('nothing has been added in game yet - data/custom.json is empty')
    else
        say('-- Paste into config.lua, then /vsportreset to clear data/custom.json.')
        say('Config.ExtraEquipment = {')
        for key in pairs(Custom.store) do
            for _, line in ipairs(Custom.toLua(key, Custom.unpack(Custom.store[key]))) do
                say(line)
            end
        end
        say('}')
    end

    print('^5==== v-sport: your custom equipment as config.lua ====^7')
    for _, line in ipairs(lines) do print(line) end
    print('^5======================================================^7')

    -- To the caller's own console too, so an admin in game does not need server console access.
    if src and src ~= 0 then
        TriggerClientEvent('vsport:client:CustomExport', src, lines)
    end
end)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A read-only view, for a menu or another resource
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

exports('GetCustomEquipment', function()
    return Custom.unpackAll(Custom.store)
end)

-- The ring over WHIP's minimap: a compass that turns with the camera, the heading in degrees, and area and street
-- under it. The map itself is WHIP's (#minimap3d), clipped round under the ring by whip/hud.css.
--   radar ..... shown when WHIP shows the minimap: in a vehicle / on foot as the player set it in WHIP's map options
--               (GetPlayerSetting 'map.inVehicle' / 'map.onFoot'), with the HUD active (logged in, alive, no screen)
--   heading ... the camera's, 20 times a second in half-degree steps (sent only when it moves)
--   location .. area and street, every second

if D11Hud.Radar == false then return end

local LOCATION_MS = 1000
local yes = Hud.yes

local function minimapShown()
    if not Hud.state.active or Hud.state.visible == false or IsPauseMenuActive() then return false end
    if yes(IsPedInAnyVehicle(PlayerPedId(), false)) then return Hud.core('GetPlayerSetting', 'map.inVehicle') ~= false end
    return Hud.core('GetPlayerSetting', 'map.onFoot') == true
end

local lastLocation = {}

local function refreshLocation()
    local pos = GetEntityCoords(PlayerPedId())
    local heading = (360.0 - ((GetGameplayCamRot(0).z + 360.0) % 360.0)) % 360.0
    local loc = {
        show = Hud.state.radar == true,
        direction = Hud.direction(heading),
        heading = heading,
        street = GetStreetNameFromHashKey((GetStreetNameAtCoord(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z))),
        area = GetLabelText(GetNameOfZone(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)),
    }
    if loc.show ~= lastLocation.show or loc.street ~= lastLocation.street or loc.area ~= lastLocation.area then
        lastLocation = loc
        Hud.set('location', loc)
    end
end

-- radar on/off, area and street
CreateThread(function()
    local nextLocation = 0
    while true do
        local show = minimapShown()
        if show ~= (Hud.state.radar == true) then
            Hud.set('radar', show)
            nextLocation = 0
        end
        if show and GetGameTimer() >= nextLocation then
            refreshLocation()
            nextLocation = GetGameTimer() + LOCATION_MS
        end
        Wait(show and 250 or 500)
    end
end)

-- the heading, light, only with the radar on screen
CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        if Hud.state.radar == true then
            local heading = math.floor(((360.0 - GetGameplayCamRot(0).z) % 360) * 2) / 2
            if Hud.state.heading ~= heading then Hud.set('heading', heading) end
            Wait(50)
        else
            Wait(250)
        end
    end
end)

-- Minimap defaults, once per PC (KVP), through WHIP's own player settings and only where the player is still on
-- WHIP's default; afterwards they change them in WHIP's map options as they like.
--   map.onFoot ............ the minimap on foot too
--   mm.viewSlow/viewFast .. 25% less zoom in a vehicle (metres shown / 0.75, on each slider's step)
if D11Hud.MapDefaults == false then return end

local MAP_DEFAULTS_KVP = 'd12_map_defaults_v1'
local MAP_DEFAULTS = {
    { key = 'map.onFoot', whip = false, d11 = true },
    { key = 'mm.viewSlow', whip = 290, d11 = 390 },   -- 290 / 0.75 = 387 (step 10)
    { key = 'mm.viewFast', whip = 800, d11 = 1050 },  -- 800 / 0.75 = 1067 (step 50)
}

AddEventHandler('whip_core:player:loaded', function()
    if GetResourceKvpString(MAP_DEFAULTS_KVP) == 'done' then return end
    SetTimeout(2000, function()
        for _, d in ipairs(MAP_DEFAULTS) do
            if Hud.core('GetPlayerSetting', d.key) == d.whip then Hud.core('SetPlayerSetting', d.key, d.d11) end
        end
        SetResourceKvp(MAP_DEFAULTS_KVP, 'done')
    end)
end)

Config = {}

-- Language: setr d11_locale en | pt-BR in server.cfg (default en). L(english, portuguese).
local PT = GetConvar('d11_locale', 'en') == 'pt-BR'
function L(en, pt) return PT and pt or en end

-- What is worn is the inventory's "Equipped" strip: slot FirstSlot + n - 1 is category n below.
-- Needs Config.ContainerSlots.accessory = 16 in whip_core/config.lua (WHIP's 5 + these 11).
Config.FirstSlot = 6

-- A category may carry more than one part: the shirt carries the top, the undershirt, the arms and the decal,
-- or the body is left without arms or clipping through. c = component, p = prop.
-- Gloves: GTA has no glove slot, a glove is an arm (component 3) with the hand covered. The Shirt keeps the bare arm
-- of its type and the Gloves item the glove, worn on the shirt's arm type (data/gloves-<body>.json, base game).
-- Earrings, bracelet and decal (printed on the Shirt) stay on the body only, with no item.
Config.Categories = {
    { key = 'shirt',    label = L('Shirt', 'Camisa'),                 c = { 11, 8, 3, 10 } },
    { key = 'pants',    label = L('Pants', 'Calça'),                  c = { 4 } },
    { key = 'shoes',    label = L('Shoes', 'Sapatos'),                c = { 6 } },
    { key = 'mask',     label = L('Mask', 'Máscara'),                 c = { 1 } },
    { key = 'neck',     label = L('Neck', 'Acessório de pescoço'),    c = { 7 } },
    { key = 'vest',     label = L('Vest', 'Colete'),                  c = { 9 } },
    { key = 'hat',      label = L('Hat', 'Chapéu'),                   p = { 0 } },
    { key = 'glasses',  label = L('Glasses', 'Óculos'),               p = { 1 } },
    { key = 'gloves',   label = L('Gloves', 'Luvas'),                 c = { 3 }, gloves = true },
    { key = 'watch',    label = L('Watch', 'Relógio'),                p = { 6 } },
    { key = 'bag',      label = L('Bag', 'Bolsa'),                    c = { 5 } },
}

-- Categories of 1.0 that left (their items still exist and can be kept, but are no longer worn from the
-- inventory): at login, an old piece in a slot that changed owner goes to the pockets.
Config.Retired = {
    { key = 'ears',     label = L('Ears (old)', 'Orelha (antiga)') },
    { key = 'bracelet', label = L('Bracelet (old)', 'Pulseira (antiga)') },
}

-- The body without the piece: the same "undressed" as WHIP's editor (whip_core/client/appearance.lua UNDRESSED),
-- by collection and number inside it. A prop without a piece is none (-1).
Config.Undressed = {
    male = {
        [1] = { 'base', 0 }, [3] = { 'base', 15 }, [4] = { 'base', 14 }, [5] = { 'base', 0 }, [6] = { 'male_apt01', 1 },
        [7] = { 'base', 0 }, [8] = { 'base', 15 }, [9] = { 'base', 0 }, [10] = { 'base', 0 }, [11] = { 'base', 15 },
    },
    female = {
        [1] = { 'base', 0 }, [3] = { 'base', 15 }, [4] = { 'base', 15 }, [5] = { 'base', 0 }, [6] = { 'female_apt01', 1 },
        [7] = { 'base', 0 }, [8] = { 'base', 14 }, [9] = { 'base', 0 }, [10] = { 'base', 0 }, [11] = { 'base', 15 },
    },
}

-- kg per piece. 0: worn clothes are not load. The strip only holds 10 kg (Config.MaxWeight.accessory) and the
-- phone, wallet and cash already fill it: with a weight, a piece was refused ("Too heavy") in the Equipped strip.
Config.Weight = 0.0

-- d11_attachments (client): porte da inspecao de arma do d12-item-inspect (client/main.lua + client/weapon.lua)
-- sobre o whip_gunny. Entrada: "Acessórios" no menu da arma (server.lua) -> saca a arma se preciso, levanta ela
-- na pose de inspecao e projeta cada ponto de encaixe (bones WAP*) na tela com Acoplar / Remover.

-- Natives deste build devolvem 1/0 (0 e verdadeiro no Lua): tudo passa por yes().
local function yes(v) return v == true or v == 1 end

local T = Config.Text
local state = nil     -- sessao aberta
local acting = false

local function notify(msg, kind) exports.whip_core:Notify(msg, kind or 'info') end
local function call(name, ...) return Whip.core:Callback('d11_attachments:' .. name, ...) end
local function gunny() local ok, w = pcall(function() return exports.whip_gunny:GetDrawnWeapon() end) return ok and w or nil end

local function waitFor(pred, timeout)
    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + timeout
    while GetGameTimer() < deadline do
        if pred() then return true end
        Wait(50)
    end
    return pred()
end

local function itemLabel(item)
    local def = exports.whip_core:GetItemDef(item)
    local att = Catalog.attachments[item]
    return (def and def.name) or (att and att.label) or item
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pose congelada (sincronizada com os outros pelo state bag, como no D12)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local POSE_BAG = 'd11AttachPose'

local function publishPose(anim, phase)
    LocalPlayer.state:set(POSE_BAG, phase and { dict = anim.dict, anim = anim.anim, phase = phase } or nil, true)
end

local function ensureAnim(ped, session)
    local a = session.anim
    if yes(IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, a.dict, a.anim, 3)) then
        if a.freezeAt and not session.frozen and GetEntityAnimCurrentTime(ped, a.dict, a.anim) >= a.freezeAt then
            SetEntityAnimCurrentTime(ped, a.dict, a.anim, a.freezeAt)
            SetEntityAnimSpeed(ped, a.dict, a.anim, 0.0)
            session.frozen = true
            publishPose(a, a.freezeAt)
        end
        return
    end
    session.frozen = false
    -- Sem esperar: o loop de frame chama de novo ate o dicionario carregar.
    if not yes(HasAnimDictLoaded(a.dict)) then RequestAnimDict(a.dict) return end
    TaskPlayAnim(ped, a.dict, a.anim, 8.0, -8.0, -1, a.flag, 0.0, false, false, false)
end

local function stopAnim(ped, session)
    local a = session.anim
    publishPose(a, nil)
    if yes(IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, a.dict, a.anim, 3)) then StopAnimTask(ped, a.dict, a.anim, 1.0) end
    RemoveAnimDict(a.dict)
end

local remotePoses = {}
AddStateBagChangeHandler(POSE_BAG, nil, function(bagName, _, value)
    local player = GetPlayerFromStateBagName(bagName)
    if not player or player == 0 or player == PlayerId() then return end
    if type(value) == 'table' and value.dict and value.anim and value.phase then
        remotePoses[player] = value
    else
        local prev = remotePoses[player]
        remotePoses[player] = nil
        local ped = prev and GetPlayerPed(player)
        if ped and ped ~= 0 and yes(IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, prev.dict, prev.anim, 3)) then
            SetEntityAnimSpeed(ped, prev.dict, prev.anim, 1.0)
        end
    end
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        if next(remotePoses) == nil then
            Wait(500)
        else
            for player, pose in pairs(remotePoses) do
                local ped = GetPlayerPed(player)
                if ped == 0 or not yes(DoesEntityExist(ped)) then
                    if not yes(NetworkIsPlayerActive(player)) then remotePoses[player] = nil end
                elseif yes(IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, pose.dict, pose.anim, 3)) then
                    if math.abs(GetEntityAnimCurrentTime(ped, pose.dict, pose.anim) - pose.phase) > 0.02 then
                        SetEntityAnimCurrentTime(ped, pose.dict, pose.anim, pose.phase)
                    end
                    SetEntityAnimSpeed(ped, pose.dict, pose.anim, 0.0)
                end
            end
            Wait(100)
        end
    end
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Camera
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function cameraLabel(mode) return T.cameraButton:format(mode == 'scripted' and T.cameraScripted or T.cameraFirst) end

local function startCamera(ped, mode)
    if mode == 'firstperson' then
        local previous = GetFollowPedCamViewMode()
        SetFollowPedCamViewMode(4)
        return { mode = mode, previous = previous }
    end
    -- Camera parada: mira um ponto fixo (onde a arma esta agora, ja na pose congelada), nao a entidade. Seguir a
    -- arma passava para a tela cada micro-movimento da mao (respiracao, idle) e os pontos tremiam.
    local o = Config.Camera.offset
    local pos = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(ped, o.x, o.y, o.z)
    local obj = GetCurrentPedWeaponEntityIndex(ped, 0)
    local target = obj ~= 0 and GetEntityCoords(obj) or GetPedBoneCoords(ped, 28422, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    local cam = CreateCam('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', true)
    SetCamCoord(cam, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
    SetCamFov(cam, Config.Camera.fov)
    PointCamAtCoord(cam, target.x, target.y, target.z)
    RenderScriptCams(true, true, Config.Camera.interp, true, true)
    return { mode = mode, cam = cam }
end

local function stopCamera(cam)
    if not cam then return end
    if cam.mode == 'firstperson' then
        SetFollowPedCamViewMode(cam.previous or 1)
    elseif cam.cam then
        RenderScriptCams(false, true, Config.Camera.interp, true, true)
        DestroyCam(cam.cam, false)
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pontos e opcoes
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function buildHotspots(weaponItem)
    local cats = Catalog.weapons[weaponItem] or {}
    local list = {}
    for _, def in ipairs(Config.Slots) do
        if (def.category and cats[def.category]) or def.magazine then
            list[#list + 1] = { id = def.id, label = def.label, category = def.category, magazine = def.magazine,
                                bones = def.bones, offset = def.offset }
        end
    end
    return list
end

local function magazineOptions()
    local w = gunny()
    if not w then return {}, nil end
    local hint = { { kind = 'info', label = T.magazineHint, disabled = true } }
    if not w.magazine then
        if w.capacity then return hint, ('%d/%d'):format(w.ammo or 0, w.capacity) end
        return hint, T.noMagazine
    end
    return hint, ('%s %d/%d'):format(itemLabel(w.magazine), w.ammo or 0, w.capacity or 0), w.magazine
end

local function buildOptions(hs)
    if hs.magazine then return magazineOptions() end
    local data = state.data
    local options = {}
    local fitted = data.attachments[hs.category]
    if fitted then
        options[1] = { kind = 'detach', category = hs.category, icon = fitted, label = T.detach:format(itemLabel(fitted)) }
    end
    local seen = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(data.carried) do
        local comp, att = Catalog.component(data.weapon, c.name)
        if comp and att.category == hs.category and not seen[c.name] then
            seen[c.name] = true
            options[#options + 1] = {
                kind = 'attach', slot = c.slot, pocket = c.pocket, icon = c.name, label = T.attach:format(itemLabel(c.name)),
                hint = (c.amount or 1) > 1 and ('x%d'):format(c.amount) or nil,
                disabled = fitted ~= nil,
                disabledReason = fitted and T.attachBlocked:format(itemLabel(fitted)) or nil,
            }
        end
    end
    return options, fitted and itemLabel(fitted) or nil, fitted
end

local function sendHotspots()
    if not state then return end
    local list = {}
    for i, hs in ipairs(state.hotspots) do
        local options, current, icon = buildOptions(hs)
        hs.options = options
        list[i] = { i = i, id = hs.id, label = hs.label, current = current or T.empty, icon = icon, options = options }
    end
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'hotspots', hotspots = list })
end

--- Card do canto esquerdo (como o info.lua do D12, so para arma): nome, descricao, serie, municao, pente, pecas.
local function sendInfo()
    if not state then return end
    local w = gunny()
    local data = state.data
    local def = exports.whip_core:GetItemDef(data.weapon) or {}
    local rows = {}
    if w and w.serial then rows[#rows + 1] = { label = T.serial, value = tostring(w.serial), mono = true } end
    if w and w.capacity then
        local pct = w.capacity > 0 and math.floor((w.ammo or 0) / w.capacity * 100) or 0
        rows[#rows + 1] = { label = T.ammo, value = ('%d/%d'):format(w.ammo or 0, w.capacity), bar = pct,
                            tone = (w.ammo or 0) == 0 and 'bad' or nil }
    end
    if w and w.magazine then rows[#rows + 1] = { label = T.magazine, value = itemLabel(w.magazine) } end
    local parts = {}
    for _, def2 in ipairs(Config.Slots) do
        local item = def2.category and data.attachments[def2.category]
        if item then parts[#parts + 1] = { label = def2.label, value = itemLabel(item), icon = item } end
    end
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'info', card = {
        kind = T.kindWeapon, label = (w and w.label) or def.name or data.weapon, icon = data.weapon,
        description = def.description or def.desc, rows = rows, parts = parts, noParts = T.noParts, partsTitle = T.parts,
    } })
end

local function hotspotWorldPos(obj, hs)
    if hs.boneObj ~= obj then
        hs.boneObj, hs.boneIndex = obj, -1
        for _, bone in ipairs(hs.bones) do
            local idx = GetEntityBoneIndexByName(obj, bone)
            if idx and idx ~= -1 then hs.boneIndex = idx break end
        end
    end
    if hs.boneIndex ~= -1 then return GetWorldPositionOfEntityBone(obj, hs.boneIndex) end
    local o = hs.offset
    return GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(obj, o.x, o.y, o.z)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Abrir / fechar
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function close()
    local session = state
    if not session then return end
    state = nil
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'close' })
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    stopCamera(session.cam)
    stopAnim(PlayerPedId(), session)
    exports.whip_core:SetScreenOpen(false)
end

local function frameLoop(session)
    local nextCheck = 0
    while state == session do
        Wait(0)
        local ped = PlayerPedId()
        DisablePlayerFiring(ped, true)
        for _, c in ipairs({ 0, 22, 23, 24, 25, 37, 44, 45, 140, 141, 142 }) do DisableControlAction(0, c, true) end

        if yes(IsEntityDead(ped)) or yes(IsPedRagdoll(ped)) or yes(IsPedInAnyVehicle(ped, false)) then close() break end

        local obj = GetCurrentPedWeaponEntityIndex(ped, 0)
        local now = GetGameTimer()
        if now >= nextCheck then
            nextCheck = now + 250
            local w = gunny()
            if not w or w.slot ~= session.slot or w.pocket ~= session.pocket then close() break end
        end
        if obj == 0 then close() break end

        ensureAnim(ped, session)
        local points = {}
        for i, hs in ipairs(session.hotspots) do
            local pos = hotspotWorldPos(obj, hs)
            local visible, sx, sy = GetScreenCoordFromWorldCoord(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
            points[i] = { i = i, x = sx, y = sy, v = yes(visible) }
        end
        SendNUIMessage({ action = 'frame', points = points })
    end
end

local function open(pocket, slot)
    if state or acting then return end
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    if yes(IsEntityDead(ped)) or yes(IsPedRagdoll(ped)) then return end
    if yes(IsPedInAnyVehicle(ped, false)) then return notify(T.inVehicle, 'error') end

    local w = gunny()
    if not w or w.slot ~= slot or w.pocket ~= pocket then
        local ok = exports.whip_gunny:DrawWeapon(slot, pocket)
        if not ok or not waitFor(function()
            local d = gunny()
            return d and d.slot == slot and d.pocket == pocket and GetCurrentPedWeaponEntityIndex(PlayerPedId(), 0) ~= 0
        end, 4000) then
            return notify(T.drawFail, 'error')
        end
        w = gunny()
    end

    local ok, data = call('data', { sub = pocket, slot = slot })
    if not ok then return notify(type(data) == 'string' and data or T.failed, 'error') end

    if yes(exports.whip_core:IsInventoryOpen()) then exports.whip_core:CloseInventory() end
    waitFor(function() return not yes(IsNuiFocused()) end, 1000)

    local hash = GetSelectedPedWeapon(ped)
    local group = GetWeapontypeGroup(hash)
    local base = Config.Anim.byGroup[group] or Config.Anim.default
    local session = {
        slot = slot, pocket = pocket, data = data,
        anim = { dict = base.dict, anim = base.anim, flag = Config.Anim.flag, freezeAt = Config.Anim.freezeAt },
        hotspots = buildHotspots(data.weapon),
        cameraMode = Config.Camera.byGroup[group] or Config.Camera.mode,
        frozen = false,
    }
    state = session
    exports.whip_core:SetScreenOpen(true)
    -- A camera so entra com a pose ja congelada: o ponto que ela mira e onde a arma fica parada.
    waitFor(function() ensureAnim(ped, session) return session.frozen end, 2000)
    session.cam = startCamera(ped, session.cameraMode)

    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'open', title = T.title, label = w and w.label or itemLabel(data.weapon), hint = T.hint,
                     camera = cameraLabel(session.cameraMode), iconBase = Config.IconBase })
    sendHotspots()
    sendInfo()
    SetNuiFocus(true, true)
    SetNuiFocusKeepInput(false)
    CreateThread(function() frameLoop(session) end)
end

RegisterNetEvent('d11_attachments:open', function(pocket, slot)
    if GetInvokingResource() then return end
    if type(slot) ~= 'number' then return end
    CreateThread(function() open(pocket or 'player', slot) end)
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Acoes
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function perform(h, o)
    local session = state
    if not session or acting then return end
    local hs = session.hotspots[h]
    local option = hs and hs.options and hs.options[o]
    if not option or option.disabled then return end

    acting = true
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'busy', value = true })
    local weapon = { sub = session.pocket, slot = session.slot }
    local ok, answer
    if option.kind == 'attach' then
        ok, answer = call('install', weapon, { sub = option.pocket, slot = option.slot })
    elseif option.kind == 'detach' then
        ok, answer = call('remove', weapon, option.category)
    end
    acting = false
    if state ~= session then return end

    if ok and type(answer) == 'table' then
        session.data = answer
    elseif not ok then
        notify(type(answer) == 'string' and answer or T.failed, 'error')
    end
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'busy', value = false })
    sendHotspots()
    sendInfo()
end

RegisterNUICallback('select', function(data, cb)
    cb(1)
    local h, o = tonumber(data and data.hotspot), tonumber(data and data.option)
    if h and o then CreateThread(function() perform(h, o) end) end
end)

RegisterNUICallback('camera', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)
    if not state then return end
    stopCamera(state.cam)
    state.cameraMode = state.cameraMode == 'firstperson' and 'scripted' or 'firstperson'
    state.cam = startCamera(PlayerPedId(), state.cameraMode)
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'camera', label = cameraLabel(state.cameraMode) })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('close', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)
    close()
end)

AddEventHandler('whip_core:player:died', close)
AddEventHandler('whip_core:player:logout', close)
AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(name) if name == GetCurrentResourceName() then close() end end)

--[[
    server/database.lua

    Persistence, through oxmysql when it is installed and through nothing at all when it is
    not.

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    WHY THERE IS NO `@oxmysql/lib/MySQL.lua` IN THE MANIFEST
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    A `server_script '@oxmysql/lib/MySQL.lua'` is a HARD dependency: the resource fails to
    start at all when oxmysql is missing, with an error that does not say why. Going through
    `exports.oxmysql` instead means a server without a database still boots, still trains,
    still shows the panel, and says so once in the console. Progress is lost on restart,
    which is a bad configuration - but it is a configuration somebody can diagnose.

    mysql-async and ghmattimysql are accepted as a fallback for older servers.

    Every query is wrapped in a promise so the callers read as straight-line code, and every
    one is guarded: a database that goes away mid-session must degrade to "not saved", never
    take a player's load path down.
]]

Database = {}

local driver                    -- 'oxmysql' | 'mysql-async' | nil
local ready = false
local warned = false

local TABLE = 'v_sport_stats'

local function started(resource)
    local state = GetResourceState(resource)
    return state == 'started' or state == 'starting'
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Driver
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function detect()
    if started('oxmysql') then
        driver = 'oxmysql'
    elseif started('mysql-async') then
        driver = 'mysql-async'
    elseif started('ghmattimysql') then
        driver = 'ghmattimysql'
    else
        driver = nil
    end

    return driver
end

--- Whether anything is being persisted. Callers use this to decide whether to warn the
--- player, not to decide whether to keep working: everything works either way.
function Database.available()
    return ready and driver ~= nil
end

function Database.driverName()
    return driver or 'none'
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Queries
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--[[
    Run a query and wait for it.

    Returns the result, or nil on any failure. `nil` is deliberately indistinguishable from
    "no rows" here: every caller treats both as "this character has no saved row", which is
    the correct behaviour for a new character and the safe behaviour for a broken database.
]]
local function query(sql, params)
    if not driver then return nil end

    local p = promise.new()
    local settled = false

    local function settle(value)
        if settled then return end
        settled = true
        p:resolve(value)
    end

    local ok = pcall(function()
        if driver == 'oxmysql' then
            exports.oxmysql:query(sql, params or {}, function(result)
                settle(result)
            end)
        elseif driver == 'mysql-async' then
            exports['mysql-async']:mysql_fetch_all(sql, params or {}, function(result)
                settle(result)
            end)
        else
            exports.ghmattimysql:execute(sql, params or {}, function(result)
                settle(result)
            end)
        end
    end)

    if not ok then
        settle(nil)
        Sport.warn('a database query threw; persistence is degraded')
        return nil
    end

    -- A driver that never calls back would hang the calling thread forever. Ten seconds is
    -- far longer than any of these queries and far shorter than a player will wait.
    SetTimeout(10000, function()
        if not settled then
            settled = true
            Sport.warn('a database query timed out after 10s')
            p:resolve(nil)
        end
    end)

    return Citizen.Await(p)
end

--- Fire and forget. Used by the flush, which has nothing to do with the result and must not
--- block the timer thread behind two hundred round trips.
local function execute(sql, params)
    if not driver then return end

    pcall(function()
        if driver == 'oxmysql' then
            exports.oxmysql:execute(sql, params or {})
        elseif driver == 'mysql-async' then
            exports['mysql-async']:mysql_execute(sql, params or {})
        else
            exports.ghmattimysql:execute(sql, params or {})
        end
    end)
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Schema
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--[[
    The table.

    LONGTEXT columns holding JSON rather than one column per stat, and that is deliberate:
    adding a fourth stat in Config.Stats has to be a config change, and a schema with a
    `strength` column would make it a migration. The cost is that you cannot ORDER BY
    strength in SQL, which is why Database.leaderboard exists.
]]
local SCHEMA = ([[
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `%s` (
    `identifier`      VARCHAR(64)  NOT NULL,
    `stats`           LONGTEXT     NOT NULL,
    `peak`            LONGTEXT     NOT NULL,
    `decay_anchor`    LONGTEXT     NOT NULL,
    `allowance`       LONGTEXT     NOT NULL,
    `last_session`    BIGINT       NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    `total_sessions`  INT          NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    `recovery_until`  BIGINT       NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    `created_at`      TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    `updated_at`      TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                                   ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (`identifier`),
    KEY `idx_last_session` (`last_session`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
]]):format(TABLE)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Boot
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CreateThread(function()
    TABLE = Config.Persistence.table or 'v_sport_stats'

    -- Guard the table name. It is interpolated into every statement below rather than bound
    -- as a parameter, because SQL will not let a table name be a placeholder. So it has to
    -- be proved safe HERE, once, rather than trusted.
    if not TABLE:match('^[%w_]+$') then
        Sport.warn(("Config.Persistence.table '%s' is not a plain identifier; refusing to use it")
            :format(TABLE))
        ready = true
        return
    end

    -- Give the database resource time to come up. A query fired at a starting oxmysql fails
    -- in a way that looks like a missing table.
    Wait(2000)

    if not detect() then
        Sport.warn('no database resource found (oxmysql, mysql-async, ghmattimysql).')
        Sport.warn('training works, but NOTHING IS SAVED. Install oxmysql to keep progress.')
        ready = true
        return
    end

    if Config.Persistence.autoCreateTable then
        query(SCHEMA:gsub('`' .. 'v_sport_stats' .. '`', '`' .. TABLE .. '`'))
    end

    -- Prove the table is actually usable rather than assuming the CREATE worked. A database
    -- user without DDL rights gets a clear message instead of a silent no-op on every save.
    local probe = query(('SELECT 1 FROM `%s` LIMIT 1'):format(TABLE))
    if probe == nil then
        Sport.warn(('table `%s` is not readable. Import sql/v_sport.sql by hand, or grant'):format(TABLE))
        Sport.warn('the database user CREATE rights and restart. Progress is NOT being saved.')
        driver = nil
        ready = true
        return
    end

    ready = true
    Sport.print(('persistence: %s, table `%s`'):format(driver, TABLE))

    -- Prune, once, at boot. Never on a timer: it is a full table scan and there is no reason
    -- to run it more than once per restart.
    local days = math.floor(tonumber(Config.Persistence.pruneAfterDays) or 0)
    if days > 0 then
        execute(('DELETE FROM `%s` WHERE `last_session` > 0 AND `last_session` < ?'):format(TABLE),
            { Sport.now() - days * 86400 })
        Sport.print(('pruning rows untouched for %d days'):format(days))
    end
end)

--- Wait until the driver has been resolved one way or the other. Callers use it so the first
--- player to join a freshly started server does not race the boot thread.
function Database.waitReady()
    local attempts = 0
    while not ready and attempts < 100 do
        Wait(100)
        attempts = attempts + 1
    end
    return ready
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Rows
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- Load one character's row, or nil when there is none. Every JSON column is decoded
--- defensively: a hand-edited row degrades to a default rather than to an error.
function Database.load(identifier)
    -- No database at all, or a bad identifier: not a failure to retry, just nothing to load.
    if not Database.available() or type(identifier) ~= 'string' or identifier == '' then
        return nil, true
    end

    local rows = query(([[
        SELECT `stats`, `peak`, `decay_anchor`, `allowance`, `last_session`,
               `total_sessions`, `recovery_until`
        FROM `%s` WHERE `identifier` = ? LIMIT 1
    ]]):format(TABLE), { identifier })

    --[[
        THREE OUTCOMES, NOT TWO. Returns `row, ok`.

        A failed or timed-out query and a character with no row both used to answer plain nil, and
        the caller read that as "new character" - so one slow query during a join installed a blank
        profile, and the next autosave wrote those zeroes over a real saved row. A player could lose
        everything to a database hiccup and nothing would say so.

        Every supported driver returns an empty TABLE for zero rows, so nil genuinely does mean the
        query did not answer. `ok = false` tells the caller to leave the profile alone.
    ]]
    if rows == nil then return nil, false end
    if type(rows) ~= 'table' or not rows[1] then return nil, true end

    local row = rows[1]

    return {
        stats = Sport.decode(row.stats, nil),
        peak = Sport.decode(row.peak, {}),
        decayAnchor = Sport.decode(row.decay_anchor, {}),
        allowance = Sport.decode(row.allowance, {}),
        lastSession = tonumber(row.last_session) or 0,
        totalSessions = tonumber(row.total_sessions) or 0,
        recoveryUntil = tonumber(row.recovery_until) or 0,
    }, true
end

--[[
    Write one character's row.

    An upsert rather than a SELECT-then-INSERT-or-UPDATE, so there is no window in which two
    saves for the same character both decide the row does not exist.
]]
function Database.save(identifier, profile)
    if not Database.available() or type(identifier) ~= 'string' or identifier == '' then
        return false
    end
    if type(profile) ~= 'table' then return false end

    execute(([[
        INSERT INTO `%s`
            (`identifier`, `stats`, `peak`, `decay_anchor`, `allowance`,
             `last_session`, `total_sessions`, `recovery_until`)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
            `stats`          = VALUES(`stats`),
            `peak`           = VALUES(`peak`),
            `decay_anchor`   = VALUES(`decay_anchor`),
            `allowance`      = VALUES(`allowance`),
            `last_session`   = VALUES(`last_session`),
            `total_sessions` = VALUES(`total_sessions`),
            `recovery_until` = VALUES(`recovery_until`)
    ]]):format(TABLE), {
        identifier,
        Sport.encode(profile.stats or {}),
        Sport.encode(profile.peak or {}),
        Sport.encode(profile.decayAnchor or {}),
        Sport.encode(profile.allowance or {}),
        math.floor(tonumber(profile.lastSession) or 0),
        math.floor(tonumber(profile.totalSessions) or 0),
        math.floor(tonumber(profile.recoveryUntil) or 0),
    })

    return true
end

--- Delete a character's row entirely. Only the admin command calls this.
function Database.delete(identifier)
    if not Database.available() or type(identifier) ~= 'string' or identifier == '' then
        return false
    end

    execute(('DELETE FROM `%s` WHERE `identifier` = ?'):format(TABLE), { identifier })
    return true
end

--[[
    The top `limit` characters by one stat.

    The stats are a JSON blob, so this cannot be an ORDER BY. It reads the rows and sorts in
    Lua, which is fine for a leaderboard on a server with thousands of characters and would
    not be for anything called per frame - hence the hard cap on how many rows come back.
]]
function Database.leaderboard(statKey, limit)
    if not Database.available() then return {} end
    if not Stats.def(statKey) then return {} end

    local rows = query(([[
        SELECT `identifier`, `stats` FROM `%s`
        WHERE `last_session` > 0
        ORDER BY `last_session` DESC
        LIMIT 2000
    ]]):format(TABLE))

    if type(rows) ~= 'table' then return {} end

    local out = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        local stats = Sport.decode(row.stats, nil)
        local value = stats and tonumber(stats[statKey])
        if value then
            out[#out + 1] = { identifier = row.identifier, value = value }
        end
    end

    table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.value > b.value end)

    local capped = {}
    for index = 1, math.min(#out, math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(limit) or 10))) do
        capped[index] = out[index]
    end

    return capped
end

-- Turbo and nitrous from whip_autos. Both are whip_core vehicle stats:
--   boost .. 1..100, the gauge's scale for -3..30 psi (whip_autos shared/power.lua: PSI_LOW, PSI_HIGH). A car carries
--            it once a turbo stage is fitted; the stage is the car's 'turbo' vehicle data ({ psi }).
--   nitro .. 0..100, a full bottle. A car carries it once a bottle is fitted.
--
-- The driver's live numbers are whip_autos' own gauge readings, which whip_core keeps to itself. With the optional
-- patch (whip_core-vehicle-stat-reading-d11.patch: exports.whip_core:GetVehicleStatReading) d11_hud reads them
-- exactly. Without it, nitro is the stat as whip_core holds it (whip_autos bills the bottle as it burns, so it moves a
-- step behind), and boost, which whip_autos only shares while someone else is in the car, comes from GTA's own turbo
-- part (whip_autos fits it with every stage) scaled to the stage's psi: the same spool, not the same number.

local PSI_LOW, PSI_HIGH, LEVEL_MAX = -3, 30, 100
local IDLE_LEVEL = 1.0
local INFO_MS = 2000        -- a car's fitted parts are read again this often (a stage bought while sitting in it)
local BURST_HOLD_MS = 400   -- nitro counts as burning this long after the bottle last went down

-- nil: not tried since whip_core started; false: whip_core has no GetVehicleStatReading (patch not applied)
local exact = nil
AddEventHandler('onClientResourceStart', function(name) if name == 'whip_core' then exact = nil end end)

local function liveReading(veh, name)
    if exact == false or GetResourceState('whip_core') ~= 'started' then return nil end
    local ok, value = pcall(function() return exports.whip_core:GetVehicleStatReading(name, { entity = veh }) end)
    exact = ok
    return ok and tonumber(value) or nil
end

local function stat(veh, name)
    return tonumber(Hud.core('GetVehicleStat', { entity = veh }, name))
end

local info = { vehicle = nil, at = 0 }
local function fitted(veh)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if info.vehicle == veh and now - info.at < INFO_MS then return info end
    local ref = { entity = veh }
    local turbo = D11Hud.Turbo ~= false and Hud.core('HasVehicleStat', ref, 'boost') == true
    local data = turbo and Hud.core('GetVehicleData', ref, 'turbo') or nil
    info = {
        vehicle = veh,
        at = now,
        turbo = turbo,
        psi = type(data) == 'table' and tonumber(data.psi) or PSI_HIGH,
        nitro = D11Hud.Nitro ~= false and Hud.core('HasVehicleStat', ref, 'nitro') == true,
    }
    return info
end

local function levelToPsi(level)
    return PSI_LOW + math.max(0, math.min(LEVEL_MAX, level)) / LEVEL_MAX * (PSI_HIGH - PSI_LOW)
end

local function boostPsi(veh, stagePsi)
    local level = liveReading(veh, 'boost')
    if level then return levelToPsi(level) end
    level = stat(veh, 'boost')
    if level and level > IDLE_LEVEL + 0.5 then return levelToPsi(level) end   -- someone else is in: the live number
    if not Hud.yes(GetIsVehicleEngineRunning(veh)) then return levelToPsi(IDLE_LEVEL) end
    local pressure = GetVehicleTurboPressure and tonumber(GetVehicleTurboPressure(veh)) or 0.0
    if pressure >= 0 then return math.min(1.0, pressure) * stagePsi end
    return math.max(PSI_LOW, pressure * -PSI_LOW)   -- off the throttle: vacuum
end

local lastNitro, burstUntil = nil, 0
local function nitroLevel(veh)
    local level = liveReading(veh, 'nitro') or stat(veh, 'nitro') or 0
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if lastNitro and level < lastNitro - 0.01 then burstUntil = now + BURST_HOLD_MS end
    lastNitro = level
    return math.max(0, math.min(1, level / LEVEL_MAX)), now < burstUntil
end

local function round(value, step) return math.floor(value / step + 0.5) * step end

local function push(key, value)
    local last = Hud.state[key]
    for k, v in pairs(value) do
        if last[k] ~= v then return Hud.set(key, value) end
    end
end

--- Called by the speedometer loop (client/vehicle.lua) for the car being driven; nil when out of it.
function Hud.power(veh)
    local car = veh and fitted(veh)
    if car and car.turbo then
        push('turbo', { visible = true, psi = round(boostPsi(veh, car.psi), 0.1), max = car.psi })
    else
        push('turbo', { visible = false, psi = 0.0, max = 0.0 })
    end
    if car and car.nitro then
        local level, burst = nitroLevel(veh)
        push('nitro', { visible = true, level = round(level, 0.005), burst = burst })
    else
        lastNitro = nil
        push('nitro', { visible = false, level = 0.0, burst = false })
    end
end
