--[[
    server/items.lua

    The consumables from Config.Items - whey first among them.

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    WHAT THIS FILE DOES AND DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DO
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    It registers a USE handler for each configured item, on whichever framework is running.

    It does NOT create the items. Creating an item means writing into qb-core's `items.lua`,
    or ESX's `items` table, or ox_inventory's `data/items.lua` - all of which belong to
    somebody else's resource. A script that silently edited one of those would break on their
    next update and leave you wondering why.

    ITEMS.md walks through adding them, framework by framework, with the exact blocks to
    paste. It takes about two minutes.

    An item that is configured here but does not exist in your inventory costs nothing: the
    handler is registered, nobody can ever have one, and it is never called.
]]

Items = {}

local function started(resource)
    local state = GetResourceState(resource)
    return state == 'started' or state == 'starting'
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Effects
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- The message shown after a successful use. Translated when the config named a locale key,
--- used verbatim when it did not.
local function notify(src, entry, ...)
    local text = entry.notify
    if type(text) ~= 'string' or text == '' then return end
    Bridge.notify(src, Locale.text(text, ...), 'success')
end

--[[
    Apply one item's effect. Returns whether it did anything.

    A `false` return means the item is NOT consumed - taking whey when your allowance is
    already full should not eat the item. That decision is made per effect below, and it is
    the difference between an item that feels fair and one that feels like a scam.
]]
local function applyEffect(src, key, entry)
    local profile = Profiles.get(src)
    if not profile then return false end

    local effect = entry.effect
    local amount = tonumber(entry.amount) or 0
    local duration = math.max(0, tonumber(entry.duration) or 0)

    -- --- Whey ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if effect == 'recovery' then
        -- Already on the shortened window with more time left than this would give? Refuse,
        -- rather than quietly wasting the item.
        local now = Sport.now()
        local remaining = (tonumber(profile.recoveryUntil) or 0) - now
        if remaining >= duration then
            Bridge.notify(src, L('item.no_effect'), 'error')
            return false
        end

        Profiles.reduceRecovery(src, duration > 0 and duration or Config.Allowance.window)
        notify(src, entry, Sport.duration(Stats.allowanceWindow(true)))

        TriggerEvent('vsport:server:ItemUsed', src, key, 'recovery')
        return true
    end

    -- --- Allowance refund ---------------------------------------------------------------
    if effect == 'allowance' then
        local spent = Profiles.allowanceSpent(profile)
        if (spent.total or 0) <= 0 then
            Bridge.notify(src, L('item.no_effect'), 'error')
            return false
        end

        Profiles.refundAllowance(src, amount)
        notify(src, entry, amount)

        TriggerEvent('vsport:server:ItemUsed', src, key, 'allowance')
        return true
    end

    -- --- Training multiplier --------------------------------------------------------------
    if effect == 'multiplier' then
        Profiles.addMultiplier(src, entry.stat, amount > 0 and amount or 1.5, duration,
            'item:' .. key)
        notify(src, entry, amount, Sport.duration(duration))

        TriggerEvent('vsport:server:ItemUsed', src, key, 'multiplier')
        return true
    end

    -- --- Temporary points -----------------------------------------------------------------
    if effect == 'buff' then
        if not Stats.def(entry.stat) then
            Sport.warn(("Config.Items.%s has effect 'buff' but no valid stat"):format(key))
            return false
        end

        Profiles.addBuff(src, entry.stat, amount, duration, 'item:' .. key)
        notify(src, entry, amount, Sport.duration(duration))

        TriggerEvent('vsport:server:ItemUsed', src, key, 'buff')
        return true
    end

    -- --- Decay protection -------------------------------------------------------------------
    if effect == 'decay_pause' then
        local profileImmune = tonumber(profile.decayImmuneUntil) or 0
        if profileImmune - Sport.now() >= duration then
            Bridge.notify(src, L('item.no_effect'), 'error')
            return false
        end

        exports[Sport.resource]:SetDecayImmunity(src, duration)
        notify(src, entry, Sport.duration(duration))

        TriggerEvent('vsport:server:ItemUsed', src, key, 'decay_pause')
        return true
    end

    -- --- Stamina ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if effect == 'stamina' then
        TriggerClientEvent('vsport:client:RestoreStamina', src,
            Sport.clamp(amount, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0))
        notify(src, entry)

        TriggerEvent('vsport:server:ItemUsed', src, key, 'stamina')
        return true
    end

    Sport.warn(("Config.Items.%s has an unknown effect '%s'"):format(key, tostring(effect)))
    return false
end

--[[
    The whole use path: cooldown, effect, consume.

    Called by every framework's handler below, so the behaviour is identical on all of them.
    Returns whether the item should be consumed.
]]
function Items.use(src, key)
    local entry = Config.Items[key]
    if type(entry) ~= 'table' or entry.item == '' then return false end

    local profile = Profiles.get(src)
    if not profile then return false end

    -- Cooldown.
    local cooldown = math.max(0, tonumber(entry.cooldown) or 0)
    if cooldown > 0 then
        local until_ = tonumber(profile.itemCooldowns[key]) or 0
        local left = until_ - Sport.now()

        if left > 0 then
            Bridge.notify(src, L('item.cooldown', Sport.duration(left)), 'error')
            return false
        end
    end

    if not applyEffect(src, key, entry) then return false end

    if cooldown > 0 then
        profile.itemCooldowns[key] = Sport.now() + cooldown
    end

    Sport.debug(('%s used %s'):format(GetPlayerName(src) or src, entry.item))
    return entry.consume ~= false
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Registration
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--
-- Each framework wants its usable items registered a different way, and ox_inventory wants
-- them registered against itself rather than against the framework. All four paths are
-- attempted; the ones whose resource is not running do nothing.

local function registerQb(key, entry)
    local core = Bridge.core()
    if not core then return false end

    --[[
        INDEXED BEHIND A pcall, because `core` is not always a plain table.

        On ox_core, Bridge.core() is an exports object, and indexing an exports object with a key it
        does not have RAISES rather than returning nil. So `core.Functions` threw, the error escaped
        the registration loop, and every item after this one in the loop was never registered -
        including on frameworks where a later registrar would have worked.

        A probe for "does this core have qb-core's shape" has to be able to answer no.
    ]]
    local ok, functions = pcall(function() return core.Functions end)
    if not ok or type(functions) ~= 'table' then return false end

    -- This path already worked, and that is the evidence that broke the qb-core stat bug open:
    -- a truthiness test plus a pcall calls a proxied method quite happily. The player lookup
    -- next door gated on type and failed on the same object, in the same boot.
    local create = functions.CreateUseableItem
    if not Sport.callable(create) then return false end

    local ok = pcall(create, entry.item, function(source_)
        if Items.use(source_, key) and entry.consume ~= false then
            local player = Bridge.player(source_)
            if player and player.Functions and player.Functions.RemoveItem then
                pcall(player.Functions.RemoveItem, entry.item, 1)
                TriggerClientEvent('inventory:client:ItemBox', source_, entry.item, 'remove')
            end
        end
    end)

    return ok
end

local function registerEsx(key, entry)
    local core = Bridge.core()
    if not core then return false end

    -- Behind a pcall for the same reason as registerQb above: on ox_core the core object is an
    -- exports table and reading a key it does not have RAISES. This one was found by the check
    -- script's new guard rather than by anybody reading the file - the same mistake twice, ten
    -- lines apart, with the reason written between them.
    local ok, register = pcall(function() return core.RegisterUsableItem end)

    -- Sport.callable, not a type test. ESX's method read off the shared object is a callable
    -- table once it has crossed a resource boundary, and a type test here silently registered
    -- no items at all - the same defect that stopped every stat loading on qb-core.
    if not ok or not Sport.callable(register) then return false end

    return pcall(register, entry.item, function(source_)
        if Items.use(source_, key) and entry.consume ~= false then
            local player = Bridge.player(source_)
            if player and player.removeInventoryItem then
                pcall(player.removeInventoryItem, entry.item, 1)
            end
        end
    end)
end

--[[
    ox_inventory.

    ONE handler for every item rather than one per item: ox_inventory fires the same event
    for everything used, so a handler per configured item would mean four handlers all
    checking the same string. The item name is looked up in a map instead.

    ox_inventory removes the item itself when it is declared with `consume = 1` in its own
    data file, so nothing is removed here.
]]
local oxItems = {}              -- item name -> config key

local function registerOxInventory()
    if not started('ox_inventory') then return false end

    AddEventHandler('ox_inventory:usedItem', function(src, name)
        local key = oxItems[name]
        if key then Items.use(src, key) end
    end)

    return true
end

CreateThread(function()
    -- Let the framework and the inventory finish starting. Registering a usable item against
    -- a resource that has not booted silently does nothing on every one of them.
    Wait(4000)

    local registered = 0

    for key, entry in pairs(Config.Items) do
        if type(entry) == 'table' and type(entry.item) == 'string' and entry.item ~= '' then
            oxItems[entry.item] = key

            local ok = registerQb(key, entry)
            if not ok then ok = registerEsx(key, entry) end
            if ok then registered = registered + 1 end
        end
    end

    if registerOxInventory() then
        Sport.debug('listening for ox_inventory:usedItem')
    end

    if registered > 0 then
        Sport.print(('registered %d usable items'):format(registered))
    end

    Sport.print('items must exist in your inventory before players can hold them - see ITEMS.md')
end)

--[[
    The universal fallback.

    A server whose inventory this resource does not know about can call this from its own use
    handler and get identical behaviour:

        exports['v-sport']:UseItem(source, 'whey')

    Returns whether the item should be consumed, so the caller knows whether to remove it.
]]
exports('UseItem', function(src, key)
    return Items.use(tonumber(src), key)
end)

--- Which items are configured, and what each does. For a shop or a documentation command.
exports('GetItems', function()
    local out = {}
    for key, entry in pairs(Config.Items) do
        if type(entry) == 'table' and entry.item ~= '' then
            out[key] = {
                item = entry.item,
                effect = entry.effect,
                amount = entry.amount,
                duration = entry.duration,
                cooldown = entry.cooldown,
                label = entry.label,
                description = entry.description,
                weight = entry.weight,
                image = entry.image,
            }
        end
    end
    return out
end)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- /vsportitems - the paste-ready blocks, generated from the config
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--
-- Registering these items is the one installation step this resource CANNOT do for itself: every
-- inventory keeps its item list somewhere different, and two of them keep it in a file that an
-- update overwrites.
--
-- What it can do is stop the block being something you transcribe by hand out of a README. This
-- generates it from Config.Items, so renaming `whey` to `proteine` or changing a weight means
-- running the command again rather than editing a file and then remembering which one.

--- Escape a single-quoted Lua string. A description with an apostrophe in it would otherwise
--- produce a block that does not parse, which is a poor first impression for an install step.
local function luaQuote(text)
    return tostring(text or ''):gsub('\\', '\\\\'):gsub("'", "\\'")
end

--- Ordered, so the generated block does not reshuffle itself between runs. `pairs` makes no
--- promises, and a block that changes order every time is one nobody can diff.
local function itemsInOrder()
    local keys = {}
    for key, entry in pairs(Config.Items) do
        if type(entry) == 'table' and entry.item and entry.item ~= '' then
            keys[#keys + 1] = key
        end
    end
    table.sort(keys)
    return keys
end

local BLOCKS = {}

BLOCKS['qb-core'] = function(lines)
    lines[#lines + 1] = '-- qb-core / qbx_core:  qb-core/shared/items.lua'
    lines[#lines + 1] = '-- Paste inside the QBShared.Items table.'
    lines[#lines + 1] = ''

    for _, key in ipairs(itemsInOrder()) do
        local it = Config.Items[key]
        lines[#lines + 1] = ("    ['%s'] = { name = '%s', label = '%s', weight = %d, "
            .. "type = 'item', image = '%s', unique = false, useable = true, "
            .. "shouldClose = true, combinable = nil, description = '%s' },")
            :format(it.item, it.item, luaQuote(it.label or it.item),
                math.floor(tonumber(it.weight) or 200), it.image or (it.item .. '.png'),
                luaQuote(it.description))
    end
end

BLOCKS['ox_inventory'] = function(lines)
    lines[#lines + 1] = '-- ox_inventory:  ox_inventory/data/items.lua'
    lines[#lines + 1] = '-- Paste inside the return table. No `useable` field: ox decides from'
    lines[#lines + 1] = '-- whether a resource registered a handler, which v-sport does at boot.'
    lines[#lines + 1] = ''

    for _, key in ipairs(itemsInOrder()) do
        local it = Config.Items[key]
        lines[#lines + 1] = ("    ['%s'] = {"):format(it.item)
        lines[#lines + 1] = ("        label = '%s',"):format(luaQuote(it.label or it.item))
        lines[#lines + 1] = ('        weight = %d,'):format(math.floor(tonumber(it.weight) or 200))
        lines[#lines + 1] = '        stack = true,'
        lines[#lines + 1] = '        close = true,'
        lines[#lines + 1] = ("        description = '%s',"):format(luaQuote(it.description))
        lines[#lines + 1] = '        client = { export = nil },'
        lines[#lines + 1] = '    },'
    end
end

BLOCKS['esx'] = function(lines)
    lines[#lines + 1] = '-- ESX (es_extended): items live in the DATABASE, not in a file.'
    lines[#lines + 1] = '-- Run this SQL once. `limit` of -1 means no per-item stack limit.'
    lines[#lines + 1] = ''
    lines[#lines + 1] = 'INSERT INTO items (name, label, weight, rare, can_remove) VALUES'

    local rows = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(itemsInOrder()) do
        local it = Config.Items[key]
        -- ESX weight is in whole units rather than grams, so a 500 g tub is not 500 units.
        local weight = math.max(1, math.floor((tonumber(it.weight) or 200) / 100))
        rows[#rows + 1] = ("    ('%s', '%s', %d, 0, 1)")
            :format(it.item, luaQuote(it.label or it.item), weight)
    end

    lines[#lines + 1] = table.concat(rows, ',\n')
    lines[#lines + 1] = 'ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE label = VALUES(label), weight = VALUES(weight);'
end

--[[
    Print the block for one inventory, or for the one this server is running.

    Defaults to what was detected rather than printing all three, because the common case is an
    operator who wants the answer and not a menu. `all` prints everything, for someone writing
    documentation or migrating between inventories.
]]
local function printItems(target, which)
    local lines = {}

    which = tostring(which or ''):lower()

    if which == '' then
        -- What is actually installed. ox_inventory is checked first because a server can run it
        -- ON TOP of qb-core, in which case ox owns the item list.
        if GetResourceState('ox_inventory') == 'started' then
            which = 'ox_inventory'
        -- Bridge.framework() answers the RESOURCE name, which for ESX is 'es_extended' - so a
        -- search for 'esx' never matched and an ESX server was handed the qb-core block.
        elseif Bridge.framework():find('es_extended') or Bridge.framework():find('esx') then
            which = 'esx'
        else
            which = 'qb-core'
        end
        lines[#lines + 1] = ('-- Detected: %s. Pass a name to this command for another one:'):format(which)
        lines[#lines + 1] = '--   qb-core | ox_inventory | esx | all'
        lines[#lines + 1] = ''
    end

    if which == 'all' then
        for _, name in ipairs({ 'qb-core', 'ox_inventory', 'esx' }) do
            BLOCKS[name](lines)
            lines[#lines + 1] = ''
        end
    elseif BLOCKS[which] then
        BLOCKS[which](lines)
    else
        lines[#lines + 1] = ('unknown inventory "%s". Known: qb-core, ox_inventory, esx, all')
            :format(which)
    end

    lines[#lines + 1] = ''
    lines[#lines + 1] = '-- Images: put images/*.png into your inventory\'s image folder.'
    lines[#lines + 1] = '-- v-sport ships SVG sources in images/ - see images/README.md.'

    print('^5==== v-sport: add these items to your inventory ====^7')
    for _, line in ipairs(lines) do print(line) end
    print('^5===================================================^7')

    if target and target ~= 0 then
        TriggerClientEvent('vsport:client:ItemBlocks', target, lines)
    end
end

exports('GetItemBlocks', function(which)
    local lines = {}
    if BLOCKS[tostring(which or 'qb-core')] then
        BLOCKS[tostring(which or 'qb-core')](lines)
    end
    return lines
end)

RegisterNetEvent('vsport:server:ItemBlocks', function(which)
    local src = source
    if Config.Commands.restrictDevCommands ~= false and not Bridge.isAdmin(src) then
        Bridge.notify(src, L('notify.no_permission'), 'error')
        return
    end
    printItems(src, which)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    local name = Config.Commands.items
    if type(name) ~= 'string' or name == '' then return end

    Bridge.addCommand(name, L('cmd.items'), {
        { name = 'inventory', help = 'qb-core | ox_inventory | esx | all' },
    }, true, function(src, rawArgs)
        local args = rawArgs
        if type(args) == 'string' then
            args = {}
            for word in rawArgs:gmatch('%S+') do args[#args + 1] = word end
        end
        printItems(src, type(args) == 'table' and args[1] or nil)
    end)
end)

-- The GPS card next to the radar ring: the next turn's arrow, the distance to it and the distance left. Only with the
-- radar on screen (Hud.state.radar, client/map.lua).
-- The waypoint: GetGpsBlipRouteLength does not see it, so its distance comes from a path calculation, or a straight
-- line when there is no path. A script route uses the native length.

if D11Hud.Radar == false or D11Hud.Route == false then return end

local ROUTE_MS = 150        -- arrow and distance to the turn
local DISTANCE_MS = 1000    -- distance left (path calculation, dearer)
local ARRIVED_METERS = 15
local WAYPOINT_SPRITE = 8
local NO_PATH_METERS = 100000.0
local yes = Hud.yes

-- The turn is read off the GPS line itself (the one WHIP's minimap draws: GetPosAlongGpsTypeRoute), not from
-- GenerateDirectionsToCoord, whose codes pointed the wrong way here. The route is sampled every STEP metres from the
-- player; the first change of heading above TURN_DEG against the current stretch is the turn: its side from the sign
-- of the angle, sharp above SHARP_DEG, and the distance to it.
local STEP, LOOK_AHEAD = 10.0, 400.0
local TURN_DEG, SHARP_DEG = 35.0, 115.0

local posAlongRoute = GetPosAlongGpsTypeRoute or function(fromPlayer, dist, slot)
    return Citizen.InvokeNative(0xF3162836C28F9DA5, Citizen.PointerValueVector(), fromPlayer, dist, slot,
        Citizen.ReturnResultAnyway())
end

--- The route's points in a slot (0 = waypoint, 1 = script route), from the player up to LOOK_AHEAD, or nil.
local function routePoints(slot)
    local pts = {}
    for d = 0.0, LOOK_AHEAD, STEP do
        local ok, p = posAlongRoute(true, d, slot)
        if ok == 0 or not ok or (type(p) ~= 'vector3' and type(p) ~= 'table') then break end
        if p.x == 0.0 and p.y == 0.0 then break end
        local last = pts[#pts]
        if last and math.abs(p.x - last.x) < 0.5 and math.abs(p.y - last.y) < 0.5 then break end   -- end of the route
        pts[#pts + 1] = p
    end
    return #pts >= 3 and pts or nil
end

--- Signed angle (degrees) from a to b: positive = left (x east, y north: anticlockwise).
local function turnAngle(ax, ay, bx, by)
    return math.deg(math.atan(ax * by - ay * bx, ax * bx + ay * by))
end

--- The line's next turn: its name and the metres to it, or 'straight' with no turn in range.
local function maneuverFromLine(pts)
    local ax, ay = pts[3].x - pts[1].x, pts[3].y - pts[1].y   -- the current stretch (20 m)
    for i = 3, #pts - 2 do
        local bx, by = pts[i + 2].x - pts[i].x, pts[i + 2].y - pts[i].y
        local angle = turnAngle(ax, ay, bx, by)
        if math.abs(angle) >= TURN_DEG then
            -- side and strength from the stretch after the turn, a little further on when there is one
            local j = math.min(#pts - 1, i + 3)
            local after = turnAngle(ax, ay, pts[j + 1].x - pts[j].x, pts[j + 1].y - pts[j].y)
            if math.abs(after) < math.abs(angle) then after = angle end
            local left = after > 0
            local name = math.abs(after) >= SHARP_DEG and (left and 'sharpLeft' or 'sharpRight') or (left and 'left' or 'right')
            return name, i * STEP   -- the stretch i..i+2 has the corner in the middle, at pts[i+1]
        end
    end
    return 'straight', nil
end

local total = { meters = 0, at = -DISTANCE_MS }

local function waypointMeters(pos, target)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if now - total.at < DISTANCE_MS then return total.meters end
    local meters = CalculateTravelDistanceBetweenPoints(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, target.x, target.y, target.z)
    if meters <= 0 or meters >= NO_PATH_METERS then
        meters = math.sqrt((target.x - pos.x) ^ 2 + (target.y - pos.y) ^ 2)
    end
    total.meters, total.at = meters, now
    return meters
end

local function readRoute()
    if Hud.state.radar ~= true then return false end
    local waypoint = yes(IsWaypointActive())
    local meters
    if waypoint then
        local target = GetBlipInfoIdCoord(GetFirstBlipInfoId(WAYPOINT_SPRITE))
        meters = math.floor(waypointMeters(GetEntityCoords(PlayerPedId()), target))
    else
        total.at = -DISTANCE_MS
        meters = math.floor(GetGpsBlipRouteLength())
    end
    if meters < ARRIVED_METERS then return false end

    local route = { meters = meters - meters % 10, maneuver = 'straight' }
    local pts = routePoints(waypoint and 0 or 1)
    if pts then
        local name, ahead = maneuverFromLine(pts)
        route.maneuver = name
        if ahead and ahead >= 10 then route.ahead = math.floor(ahead - ahead % 10) end
    end
    return route
end

local function refreshRoute()
    local route = readRoute()
    local last = Hud.state.route
    if not route and not last then return end
    if route and last and route.meters == last.meters and route.maneuver == last.maneuver
        and route.ahead == last.ahead then return end
    Hud.set('route', route)
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        if not yes(IsPauseMenuActive()) then refreshRoute() end
        Wait(ROUTE_MS)
    end
end)

-- A small seatbelt (WHIP has none). The key toggles it; a crash above D11Hud.Seatbelt.EjectKmh without it
-- (EjectBuckledKmh with it) throws you through the windscreen; buckled, F (leave the vehicle) is blocked; getting out
-- unbuckles. Motorbikes, bicycles, boats and aircraft have no belt.
-- The driver sees it on the speedometer (client/vehicle.lua reads Hud.state.seatbelt), a passenger on a small icon.
-- LocalPlayer.state.seatbelt (local only) is there for other resources to read.

local L = D11Hud.L
local cfg = D11Hud.Seatbelt
local NO_BELT = { [8] = true, [13] = true, [14] = true, [15] = true, [16] = true }
local yes = Hud.yes

Hud.state.seatbelt = false
Hud.state.passengerBelt = { visible = false, buckled = false }

function Hud.hasSeatbelt(vehicle)
    return cfg.Enabled ~= false and vehicle ~= 0 and not NO_BELT[GetVehicleClass(vehicle)]
end

if cfg.Enabled == false then return end

local KMH = 3.6
local EJECT_UNBUCKLED = (tonumber(cfg.EjectKmh) or 20) / KMH
local EJECT_BUCKLED = (tonumber(cfg.EjectBuckledKmh) or 160) / KMH

local function currentVehicle()
    local vehicle = GetVehiclePedIsIn(PlayerPedId(), false)
    if vehicle ~= 0 and yes(DoesEntityExist(vehicle)) then return vehicle end
    return 0
end

local function setBelt(buckled)
    if Hud.state.seatbelt == buckled then return end
    Hud.set('seatbelt', buckled)
    LocalPlayer.state:set('seatbelt', buckled, false)
    SetFlyThroughWindscreenParams(buckled and EJECT_BUCKLED or EJECT_UNBUCKLED, 1.0, 17.0, 10.0)
    PlaySoundFrontend(-1, buckled and 'NAV_UP_DOWN' or 'NAV_LEFT_RIGHT', 'HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET', true)
end

RegisterCommand('d11_seatbelt', function()
    if IsPauseMenuActive() or not Hud.state.active then return end
    if not Hud.hasSeatbelt(currentVehicle()) then return end
    setBelt(not Hud.state.seatbelt)
end, false)
RegisterKeyMapping('d11_seatbelt', L('Vehicle: seatbelt', 'Veículo: cinto de segurança'), 'keyboard', cfg.Key or 'B')

local function passengerSeat(vehicle, ped)
    for seat = 0, GetVehicleMaxNumberOfPassengers(vehicle) - 1 do
        if GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, seat) == ped then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function pushPassenger(vehicle)
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    local visible = Hud.state.active and Hud.hasSeatbelt(vehicle) and passengerSeat(vehicle, ped)
    local belt = Hud.state.passengerBelt
    if belt.visible == visible and belt.buckled == Hud.state.seatbelt then return end
    Hud.set('passengerBelt', { visible = visible, buckled = Hud.state.seatbelt })
end

CreateThread(function()
    SetFlyThroughWindscreenParams(EJECT_UNBUCKLED, 1.0, 17.0, 10.0)
    while true do
        local vehicle = currentVehicle()
        if vehicle == 0 then
            setBelt(false)
            pushPassenger(0)
            Wait(500)
        elseif Hud.state.seatbelt then
            DisableControlAction(0, 75, true) -- F: leave the vehicle
            DisableControlAction(27, 75, true)
            pushPassenger(vehicle)
            Wait(0)
        else
            pushPassenger(vehicle)
            Wait(250)
        end
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then return end
    LocalPlayer.state:set('seatbelt', false, false)
    SetFlyThroughWindscreenParams(EJECT_UNBUCKLED, 1.0, 17.0, 10.0)
end)

-- d11_attachments (server): o "Acessorios" no menu das armas do gunny, e acoplar / remover com a arma em maos.
-- Mesma regra da bancada do gunny (server/attachments.lua): tira antes de dar, desfaz o que ficou pela metade,
-- grava em metadata.attachments (+ attachmentMeta, o metadata do item acoplado) e avisa o cliente do gunny
-- (whip_gunny:client:attachmentInstalled/Removed) para por/tirar o componente da arma sacada.
-- Diferenca: sem a checagem de distancia da bancada (BENCH_NEAR).

--- O que o painel precisa: os acessorios na arma e os que o jogador carrega (com o endereco de cada um).
local function panelData(source, weaponItem, meta)
    local carried = {}
    for attName in pairs(Catalog.attachments) do
        local all = Whip.core:FindAllItems(source, attName)
        for _, found in ipairs(type(all) == 'table' and all or {}) do
            carried[#carried + 1] = { slot = found.addr.slot, pocket = found.addr.sub, name = found.item,
                                      amount = found.amount }
        end
    end
    return { weapon = weaponItem, attachments = (meta or {}).attachments or {}, carried = carried }
end

local function weaponSchema(extra)
    local params = { { 'weapon', 'slot' } }
    for _, p in ipairs(extra or {}) do params[#params + 1] = p end
    return { rateLimit = 300, burst = 6, params = params }
end

local function takesAttachments(item)
    return Catalog.weapons[item] ~= nil and next(Catalog.weapons[item]) ~= nil
end

local Calls = {}

function Calls.data(source, weapon)
    if not takesAttachments(weapon.item) then return false, Config.Text.noAttachments end
    return true, panelData(source, weapon.item, weapon.metadata)
end

function Calls.install(source, weapon, attachment)
    if not takesAttachments(weapon.item) then return false, Config.Text.noAttachments end
    local componentHash, att = Catalog.component(weapon.item, attachment.item)
    if not componentHash then return false, Config.Text.wrongAttachment end

    local meta = weapon.metadata or {}
    meta.attachments = meta.attachments or {}
    if meta.attachments[att.category] then return false, Config.Text.slotTaken end

    local removed, why = exports.whip_core:StoreTake(attachment.addr, 1, { reason = 'acoplado na arma' })
    if not removed then return false, why or Config.Text.takeFailed end

    local fitted = {}
    for k, v in pairs(type(removed) == 'table' and type(removed.metadata) == 'table' and removed.metadata or {}) do
        fitted[k] = v
    end
    meta.attachments[att.category] = attachment.item
    meta.attachmentMeta = meta.attachmentMeta or {}
    meta.attachmentMeta[att.category] = fitted
    if not exports.whip_core:SetItemMetadata(weapon.addr, meta) then
        local back = Whip.core:AddItem(source, attachment.item, 1, next(fitted) and fitted or nil, 'acoplar desfeito')
        if not back then print(('[d11_attachments] %s PERDIDO: arma nao gravou e o item nao voltou'):format(attachment.item)) end
        return false, Config.Text.saveFailed
    end

    TriggerClientEvent('whip_gunny:client:attachmentInstalled', source, weapon.addr.slot, att.category, attachment.item, componentHash)
    return true, panelData(source, weapon.item, meta)
end

function Calls.remove(source, weapon, category)
    local meta = weapon.metadata or {}
    local attName = (meta.attachments or {})[category]
    if not attName then return false, Config.Text.nothingThere end
    local componentHash = Catalog.component(weapon.item, attName)

    -- Sai da arma primeiro; o AddItem pode esperar (bolsos cheios largam no chao).
    meta.attachments[category] = nil
    local fitted = type(meta.attachmentMeta) == 'table' and meta.attachmentMeta[category] or nil
    if not fitted and type(meta.attachmentUids) == 'table' and meta.attachmentUids[category] then
        fitted = { uid = meta.attachmentUids[category] }
    end
    if type(meta.attachmentMeta) == 'table' then meta.attachmentMeta[category] = nil end
    if type(meta.attachmentUids) == 'table' then meta.attachmentUids[category] = nil end
    if not exports.whip_core:SetItemMetadata(weapon.addr, meta) then return false, Config.Text.saveFailed end

    if not Whip.core:AddItem(source, attName, 1, fitted, 'retirado da arma') then
        -- Sem lugar nenhum: volta para a arma, se ela ainda estiver no mesmo slot.
        local now = Whip.core:GetItemAt(weapon.addr)
        local ok = false
        if type(now) == 'table' and now.item == weapon.item then
            local nowMeta = now.metadata or {}
            if nowMeta.serial == meta.serial then
                nowMeta.attachments = nowMeta.attachments or {}
                nowMeta.attachments[category] = attName
                if fitted then
                    nowMeta.attachmentMeta = nowMeta.attachmentMeta or {}
                    nowMeta.attachmentMeta[category] = fitted
                end
                ok = Whip.core:SetItemMetadata(weapon.addr, nowMeta) == true
            end
        end
        if not ok then print(('[d11_attachments] %s PERDIDO: sem espaco e a arma nao aceitou de volta'):format(attName)) end
        return false, Config.Text.noRoom
    end

    TriggerClientEvent('whip_gunny:client:attachmentRemoved', source, weapon.addr.slot, category, componentHash)
    return true, panelData(source, weapon.item, meta)
end

local SCHEMAS = {
    data = weaponSchema(),
    install = weaponSchema({ { 'attachment', 'slot' } }),
    remove = weaponSchema({ { 'category', 'key', 64 } }),
}

Whip.register(function()
    for name, schema in pairs(SCHEMAS) do
        Whip.core:SecureCallback('d11_attachments:' .. name, schema, function(source, _, ...)
            return Calls[name](source, ...)
        end)
    end

    Whip.core:RegisterContextAction(Config.MenuAction, function(source, _, slotData, addr)
        if not (slotData and takesAttachments(slotData.item)) then return end
        TriggerClientEvent('d11_attachments:open', source, addr.sub or 'player', addr.slot)
    end)

    local count = 0
    for weaponItem in pairs(Catalog.weapons) do
        if takesAttachments(weaponItem) then
            local ok, why = Whip.core:AddItemOption(weaponItem, { action = Config.MenuAction, label = Config.MenuLabel, order = 5 })
            if ok then count = count + 1 else print(('[d11_attachments] %s: %s'):format(weaponItem, tostring(why))) end
        end
    end
    print(('[d11_attachments] "%s" on %d gunny weapons'):format(Config.MenuLabel, count))
end)

-- Clothing as items. What is worn is the inventory's "Equipped" strip (slots 6-16, one per category): WHIP keeps,
-- weighs and logs it; this only decides what goes on the body.
--
--   strip changed (drag, use, give, drop)   -> the client dresses only the changed categories and saves the look
--   editor saved (store, /charedit, admin)  -> what changed in the look becomes an item in its slot; the old one goes
--   first login with this resource           -> the saved look's clothes become items (once per character)
--   later logins                             -> the strip rules: the body wears what is in it

local CAT, SLOT_OF, CAT_OF_SLOT, CAT_OF_ITEM = {}, {}, {}, {}
for i, c in ipairs(Config.Categories) do
    local slot = Config.FirstSlot + i - 1
    CAT[c.key], SLOT_OF[c.key], CAT_OF_SLOT[slot] = c, slot, c.key
    CAT_OF_ITEM['d11_clothing_' .. c.key] = c.key
end

local CONVERTED = 'd11_clothing'   -- character metadata: the saved look's clothes already became items (= version)
-- 2: Gloves and Bag became items (in the old Ears and Bracelet slots). A character converted by 1.0 converts once
-- more, so the gloves and bag already worn get into the strip.
local VERSION = 2
local BODY = { male = L('Male', 'Masculino'), female = L('Female', 'Feminino') }

local function itemOf(cat) return 'd11_clothing_' .. cat end
local function strip(src, slot) return { kind = 'player', id = src, sub = 'accessory', slot = slot } end
local function pockets(src) return { kind = 'player', id = src, sub = 'player' } end
local function tell(src, msg, kind) exports.whip_core:NotifyPlayer(src, msg, kind or 'error') end

--- A list of parts as comparable text ('' = no piece).
local function signature(parts)
    if type(parts) ~= 'table' then return '' end
    local out = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do out[#out + 1] = ('%s%d:%s:%d:%d'):format(p.t, p.s, p.col, p.i, p.tex) end
    return table.concat(out, '|')
end

-- [src] = { gender, worn = { [cat] = signature the body has } }
local state = {}

--- A clothing slot holding a piece that is not its own (the 1.0 Ears / Bracelet, or the slot changed category): the
--- piece goes to the pockets, so the slot can take the right one.
local function vacate(src)
    local s = exports.whip_core:StoreRead({ kind = 'player', id = src, sub = 'accessory' })
    for slot, it in pairs((s or {}).items or {}) do
        local cat = CAT_OF_SLOT[tonumber(slot)]
        if cat and it.item ~= itemOf(cat) then
            local ok = exports.whip_core:StoreMove(strip(src, tonumber(slot)), pockets(src), { reason = 'd11_clothing: slot changed' })
            if not ok then print(('[d11_clothing] %s: %s in slot %s did not fit in the pockets'):format(src, it.item, slot)) end
        end
    end
end

--- The pieces in the strip, by category.
local function readStrip(src)
    local out = {}
    local s = exports.whip_core:StoreRead({ kind = 'player', id = src, sub = 'accessory' })
    if not s then return out end
    for slot, it in pairs(s.items or {}) do
        local cat = CAT_OF_SLOT[tonumber(slot)]
        if cat and it.item == itemOf(cat) then out[cat] = it end
    end
    return out
end

-- ============================================
-- What the client sends: checked here
-- ============================================

local function int(v, max) return type(v) == 'number' and v == math.floor(v) and v >= 0 and v <= max end

--- { parts, piece, tex } for a category, or false (no piece), or nil if it came in wrong.
local function cleanPiece(cat, v)
    if v == false then return false end
    if type(v) ~= 'table' or type(v.parts) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    local c, accepted = CAT[cat], {}
    for _, s in ipairs(c.c or {}) do accepted['c' .. s] = true end
    for _, s in ipairs(c.p or {}) do accepted['p' .. s] = true end
    local parts = {}
    for n, p in ipairs(v.parts) do
        if n > 4 or type(p) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if not accepted[tostring(p.t) .. tostring(p.s)] then return nil end
        if type(p.col) ~= 'string' or #p.col > 64 or not p.col:match('^[%w_]+$') then return nil end
        if not int(p.i, 4095) or not int(p.tex, 255) then return nil end
        parts[n] = { t = p.t, s = p.s, col = p.col, i = p.i, tex = p.tex }
    end
    if #parts == 0 then return nil end
    local piece = type(v.piece) == 'string' and v.piece:sub(1, 40) or c.label
    return { parts = parts, piece = piece, tex = parts[1].tex }
end

local function metadataOf(gender, v)
    local p = v.parts[1]
    local dir = p.t == 'c' and ('c' .. p.s) or ('p' .. p.s)
    return {
        gender = gender,
        body = BODY[gender],
        piece = v.piece,
        colour = tostring(v.tex),
        parts = v.parts,
        -- The real picture (whip_core's clothing photos), for an inventory renderer that reads it (d11_inventory).
        foto = ('%s/%s/%s/%03d/%02d'):format(gender, dir, p.col, p.i, p.tex),
    }
end

-- ============================================
-- Strip -> body
-- ============================================

local busy = {}

local function sync(src)
    local e = state[src]
    if not e then return end
    if busy[src] then busy[src] = 'again' return end
    busy[src] = true
    local pieces, changed = readStrip(src), {}
    for _, c in ipairs(Config.Categories) do
        local it = pieces[c.key]
        local meta = it and it.metadata or {}
        if it and meta.gender ~= e.gender then
            -- A piece for the other body: back to the pockets (or it stays, if it does not fit, without dressing).
            exports.whip_core:StoreMove(strip(src, SLOT_OF[c.key]), pockets(src), { reason = 'd11_clothing: other body' })
            tell(src, L('That piece is for the other body.', 'Essa peça é de outro corpo.'))
            it = nil
        end
        local parts = it and meta.parts or false
        local sig = signature(parts)
        if e.worn[c.key] ~= sig then
            e.worn[c.key] = sig
            changed[c.key] = parts
        end
    end
    if next(changed) then TriggerClientEvent('d11_clothing:dress', src, changed) end
    local again = busy[src] == 'again'
    busy[src] = nil
    if again then sync(src) end
end

AddEventHandler('whip_core:inventory:changed', function(d)
    if type(d) == 'table' and d.source then sync(d.source) end
end)

-- ============================================
-- Look -> strip (editor saved, first login)
-- ============================================

--- `current[cat]` = { parts, piece, tex } or false, from the saved look. Makes the strip match it.
--- Returns false if some piece did not get into the strip.
local function reconcile(src, current)
    local e = state[src]
    local pieces = readStrip(src)
    local allIn = true
    busy[src] = true   -- the swaps below fire inventory:changed: the body already looks like this
    for _, c in ipairs(Config.Categories) do
        local target = cleanPiece(c.key, current[c.key])
        if target ~= nil then
            local it, slot = pieces[c.key], SLOT_OF[c.key]
            local sigTarget = signature(target and target.parts)
            local sigItem = it and signature(it.metadata and it.metadata.parts) or ''
            if it and (it.metadata or {}).gender ~= e.gender then
                -- The body changed in the editor: the old piece does not fit, but it is theirs. To the pockets.
                exports.whip_core:StoreMove(strip(src, slot), pockets(src), { reason = 'd11_clothing: other body' })
                it, sigItem = nil, ''
            end
            local worn = sigTarget
            if sigTarget ~= sigItem then
                if it then exports.whip_core:StoreTake(strip(src, slot), nil, 'd11_clothing: changed in the editor') end
                if target then
                    local ok, why = exports.whip_core:StoreGive(strip(src, slot), itemOf(c.key), 1,
                        metadataOf(e.gender, target), 'd11_clothing: put on in the editor')
                    if not ok then
                        print(('[d11_clothing] %s: %s did not fit in the strip: %s'):format(src, c.key, tostring(why)))
                        -- The body still wears it, but the slot is empty: note it as empty, or the next strip change
                        -- would "take off" this category too.
                        worn, allIn = '', false
                    end
                end
            end
            e.worn[c.key] = worn
        end
    end
    busy[src] = nil
    return allIn
end

local function validGender(g) return g == 'male' or g == 'female' end

-- Login (and a restart of this resource with the player in game).
RegisterNetEvent('d11_clothing:ready', function(gender, current)
    local src = source
    if not validGender(gender) or type(current) ~= 'table' then return end
    state[src] = { gender = gender, worn = {} }
    vacate(src)
    if (tonumber((exports.whip_core:GetPlayerMetadata(src, CONVERTED))) or 0) < VERSION then
        -- Marked converted only if every piece got in: otherwise the next login tries again.
        if reconcile(src, current) then exports.whip_core:SetPlayerMetadata(src, CONVERTED, VERSION) end
        return
    end
    -- The strip rules: the body wears exactly what is in it.
    local pieces, all = readStrip(src), {}
    for _, c in ipairs(Config.Categories) do
        local it = pieces[c.key]
        local parts = it and (it.metadata or {}).gender == gender and it.metadata.parts or false
        state[src].worn[c.key] = signature(parts)
        all[c.key] = parts
    end
    TriggerClientEvent('d11_clothing:dress', src, all)
end)

local function inStore(src)
    return GetResourceState('d11_stores') == 'started' and exports.d11_stores:InStore(src)
end

-- WHIP's editor saves the look through this event (whip_core/server/events_misc.lua). We listen to the same name:
-- the client checks whether the clothes changed and, if so, sends what is worn.
RegisterNetEvent('whip_core:server:saveAppearance', function(appearance)
    local src = source
    -- At a d11_stores store the purchase comes as d11_stores:paid instead.
    if inStore(src) then return end
    -- A new character: at login there was no look yet (the creator was open), so no 'ready' and no state. The
    -- creator's first save counts as the login: the client checks and the clothes become items right away.
    if type(appearance) == 'table' then TriggerClientEvent('d11_clothing:check', src, appearance) end
end)

-- A purchase paid at a d11_stores store: the client checks the new look and sends what is worn.
AddEventHandler('d11_stores:paid', function(src, appearance)
    if state[src] and type(appearance) == 'table' then TriggerClientEvent('d11_clothing:check', src, appearance) end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('d11_clothing:editor', function(gender, current)
    local src = source
    if not validGender(gender) or type(current) ~= 'table' then return end
    local e = state[src]
    if not e then
        -- A new character's first look (see saveAppearance above): the state starts here and, if every piece got
        -- in, the character is marked converted, so the next login does not convert again.
        e = { gender = gender, worn = {} }
        state[src] = e
        vacate(src)
        if reconcile(src, current) and (tonumber((exports.whip_core:GetPlayerMetadata(src, CONVERTED))) or 0) < VERSION then
            exports.whip_core:SetPlayerMetadata(src, CONVERTED, VERSION)
        end
        return
    end
    e.gender = gender
    vacate(src)
    reconcile(src, current)
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function() state[source], busy[source] = nil, nil end)
AddEventHandler('whip_core:player:logout', function(d)
    local src = type(d) == 'table' and d.source or source
    if src then state[src], busy[src] = nil, nil end
end)

-- ============================================
-- Items, slots and Use (put on / take off)
-- ============================================

local function use(src, slotData, addr)
    local cat = CAT_OF_ITEM[slotData.item]
    if not cat then return false end
    if addr and addr.sub == 'accessory' then
        local ok = exports.whip_core:StoreMove(addr, pockets(src), { reason = 'd11_clothing: take off' })
        if not ok then return false, L('It does not fit in your pockets', 'Não cabe nos bolsos') end
        return false
    end
    local e = state[src]
    if not e then return false, L('Wait for your character to load', 'Aguarde o personagem carregar') end
    if (slotData.metadata or {}).gender ~= e.gender then return false, L('That piece is for the other body', 'Essa peça é de outro corpo') end
    local target = strip(src, SLOT_OF[cat])
    if exports.whip_core:GetItemAt(target) then
        local ok = exports.whip_core:StoreMove(target, pockets(src), { reason = 'd11_clothing: swap' })
        if not ok then return false, L('The piece you are wearing does not fit in your pockets', 'Não cabe nos bolsos a peça que você está vestindo') end
    end
    local ok, why = exports.whip_core:StoreMove(addr, target, { reason = 'd11_clothing: put on' })
    if not ok then return false, why or L('Could not put it on', 'Não deu para vestir') end
    return false
end

Whip.register(function()
    for _, c in ipairs(Config.Categories) do
        local key = itemOf(c.key)
        local ok, why = Whip.core:RegisterItem(key, {
            name = c.label,
            desc = L('Clothing. Use to put it on or take it off; worn, it sits in Equipped.',
                     'Roupa. Use para vestir ou tirar; vestida, fica no Equipado.'),
            weight = Config.Weight, type = 'clothing', stack = false, usable = true,
            metaFields = {
                { key = 'piece', label = L('Piece', 'Peça') },
                { key = 'colour', label = L('Colour', 'Cor') },
                { key = 'body', label = L('Body', 'Corpo') },
            },
        })
        if not ok then print(('[d11_clothing] item %s refused: %s'):format(key, tostring(why))) end
        Whip.core:RegisterUseHandler(key, function(src, _, slotData, addr) return use(src, slotData, addr) end)
        local okSlot, whySlot = Whip.core:RegisterAccessorySlot({ slot = SLOT_OF[c.key], accepts = key, label = c.label })
        if not okSlot then print(('[d11_clothing] slot %d (%s) refused: %s'):format(SLOT_OF[c.key], c.label, tostring(whySlot))) end
    end
    -- Pieces of categories that left (Ears, Bracelet): still items, just not worn from the inventory.
    for _, c in ipairs(Config.Retired or {}) do
        local key = itemOf(c.key)
        local ok, why = Whip.core:RegisterItem(key, {
            name = c.label,
            desc = L('An old clothing piece: no longer worn from the inventory. Keep, sell or drop it.',
                     'Peça de roupa antiga: não se veste mais pelo inventário. Pode guardar, vender ou descartar.'),
            weight = Config.Weight, type = 'clothing', stack = false, usable = false,
            metaFields = {
                { key = 'piece', label = L('Piece', 'Peça') },
                { key = 'colour', label = L('Colour', 'Cor') },
                { key = 'body', label = L('Body', 'Corpo') },
            },
        })
        if not ok then print(('[d11_clothing] item %s refused: %s'):format(key, tostring(why))) end
    end
end)

-- The HUD's single state. Every change goes through Hud.set; when the page (re)loads it asks for the whole snapshot.

Hud = {
    state = {
        active = false,        -- logged in, alive and no WHIP screen open (client/status.lua)
        visible = true,
        inventoryOpen = false, -- WHIP's inventory already counts as an open screen
        locale = D11Hud.Locale,
        logo = D11Hud.Logo == true,
        showStatus = D11Hud.Status ~= false,
        nitro = { visible = false, level = 0.0, burst = false },
        turbo = { visible = false, psi = 0.0, max = 0.0 },
    },
}

-- Natives in this build can answer 1/0 instead of a boolean (0 is true in Lua): every check goes through yes().
function Hud.yes(value) return value == true or value == 1 end

function Hud.set(key, value)
    Hud.state[key] = value
    SendNUIMessage({ action = key, payload = value })
end

function Hud.snapshot()
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'snapshot', payload = Hud.state })
end

--- exports.whip_core:<name>(...) without breaking while whip_core starts or restarts.
function Hud.core(name, ...)
    if GetResourceState('whip_core') ~= 'started' then return nil end
    local args = { ... }
    local ok, value = pcall(function() return exports.whip_core[name](exports.whip_core, table.unpack(args)) end)
    if ok then return value end
end

RegisterNUICallback('ready', function(_, cb)
    Hud.snapshot()
    cb({ ok = true })
end)

-- the speedometer reports its own edge (the action hints move left of it); nothing to answer
RegisterNUICallback('gaugeBounds', function(_, cb) cb({ ok = true }) end)

-- d11_mapnomes: reads street names (along GTA's road nodes) and districts (zones) from the game and sends them to the
-- server, which saves labels.js for the pause map. Runs once, when an admin asks with /d11mapnomes (server.lua).
-- Saved as GTA's street hashes and zone codes: every player sees the names in their own game language.

local BOUNDS = { x1 = -4000.0, y1 = -4200.0, x2 = 4600.0, y2 = 8400.0 }
local CHUNK = 1000.0        -- m: road nodes load by area
local STEP = 60.0           -- m: the grid that looks for the nearest node
local ZONE_STEP = 120.0     -- m: the zones' grid
local LABEL_GAP = 320.0     -- m: between two labels of the same street
local MAX_PER_STREET = 14

local PT = GetConvar('d11_locale', 'en') == 'pt-BR'
local TEXT = PT and {
    start = 'Nomes do mapa: lendo ruas e bairros do GTA (1-2 min)...',
    streets = 'Nomes do mapa: ruas %d%%',
    failed = 'Nomes do mapa: falhou - %s',
    sending = 'Nomes do mapa: %d ruas, %d rótulos, %d bairros. Salvando...',
} or {
    start = 'Map names: reading streets and districts from GTA (1-2 min)...',
    streets = 'Map names: streets %d%%',
    failed = 'Map names: failed - %s',
    sending = 'Map names: %d streets, %d labels, %d districts. Saving...',
}

-- Natives called by hash: their Lua names changed between FiveM versions.
local function requestNodes(x1, y1, x2, y2) return Citizen.InvokeNative(0x07FB139B592FA687, x1, y1, x2, y2) end
local function nodesLoaded(x1, y1, x2, y2) return Citizen.InvokeNative(0xF7B79A50B905A30D, x1, y1, x2, y2) end
local function topZ(x, y) return Citizen.InvokeNative(0x29C24BFBED8AB8FB, x, y, Citizen.ResultAsFloat()) or 0.0 end

local function say(msg)
    BeginTextCommandPrint('STRING')
    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(msg)
    EndTextCommandPrint(2500, true)
    print('[d11_mapnomes] ' .. msg)
end

local running = false

local function collect()
    local nodes, seen = {}, {}
    local nx = math.ceil((BOUNDS.x2 - BOUNDS.x1) / CHUNK)
    local ny = math.ceil((BOUNDS.y2 - BOUNDS.y1) / CHUNK)
    local chunks, done = nx * ny, 0

    for ci = 0, nx - 1 do
        for cj = 0, ny - 1 do
            local x1, y1 = BOUNDS.x1 + ci * CHUNK, BOUNDS.y1 + cj * CHUNK
            local x2, y2 = x1 + CHUNK, y1 + CHUNK
            -- Asked every frame until it loads (GTA lets the area go when the asking stops).
            local deadline = GetGameTimer() + 4000
            while not nodesLoaded(x1, y1, x2, y2) and GetGameTimer() < deadline do
                requestNodes(x1, y1, x2, y2)
                Wait(0)
            end
            local n = 0
            for x = x1 + STEP / 2, x2, STEP do
                for y = y1 + STEP / 2, y2, STEP do
                    local ok, pos, heading = GetClosestVehicleNodeWithHeading(x, y, topZ(x, y), 1, 3.0, 0)
                    if ok and pos and math.abs(pos.x - x) < STEP and math.abs(pos.y - y) < STEP then
                        local key = math.floor(pos.x / 8) .. ':' .. math.floor(pos.y / 8)
                        if not seen[key] then
                            seen[key] = true
                            local street = GetStreetNameAtCoord(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
                            if street and street ~= 0 and GetStreetNameFromHashKey(street) ~= '' then
                                nodes[#nodes + 1] = { street, pos.x, pos.y, heading or 0.0 }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    n = n + 1
                    if n % 250 == 0 then requestNodes(x1, y1, x2, y2); Wait(0) end
                end
            end
            done = done + 1
            if done % 10 == 0 then say(TEXT.streets:format(math.floor(done * 100 / chunks))) end
        end
    end

    -- Streets: each street's nodes; labels spaced along it, with the road's direction.
    local byHash, order = {}, {}
    for _, n in ipairs(nodes) do
        local list = byHash[n[1]]
        if not list then list = {}; byHash[n[1]] = list; order[#order + 1] = n[1] end
        list[#list + 1] = n
    end
    local streets = {}
    for _, hash in ipairs(order) do
        local list, chosen = byHash[hash], {}
        local prio = #list   -- the longer the road, the sooner it shows
        for _, n in ipairs(list) do
            if #chosen >= MAX_PER_STREET then break end
            local far = true
            for _, c in ipairs(chosen) do
                if (c[2] - n[2]) ^ 2 + (c[3] - n[3]) ^ 2 < LABEL_GAP * LABEL_GAP then far = false; break end
            end
            if far then
                chosen[#chosen + 1] = n
                streets[#streets + 1] = { hash, math.floor(n[2]), math.floor(n[3]), math.floor(n[4]), prio }
            end
        end
    end

    -- Districts: the middle of each GTA zone, by the grid.
    local acc, zorder, k = {}, {}, 0
    for x = BOUNDS.x1, BOUNDS.x2, ZONE_STEP do
        for y = BOUNDS.y1, BOUNDS.y2, ZONE_STEP do
            local code = GetNameOfZone(x, y, topZ(x, y))
            if code and code ~= '' and code:upper() ~= 'OCEANA' and code:upper() ~= 'SANAND' then
                local z = acc[code]
                if not z then z = { sx = 0.0, sy = 0.0, n = 0 }; acc[code] = z; zorder[#zorder + 1] = code end
                z.sx, z.sy, z.n = z.sx + x, z.sy + y, z.n + 1
            end
            k = k + 1
            if k % 400 == 0 then Wait(0) end
        end
    end
    local zones = {}
    for _, code in ipairs(zorder) do
        local z, label = acc[code], GetLabelText(code)
        if label and label ~= 'NULL' and label ~= '' then
            zones[#zones + 1] = { code, math.floor(z.sx / z.n), math.floor(z.sy / z.n), z.n }
        end
    end

    return { v = 2, streets = streets, zones = zones }, #order
end

RegisterNetEvent('d11_mapnomes:collect', function()
    if running then return end
    running = true
    say(TEXT.start)
    local ok, data, names = pcall(collect)
    running = false
    if not ok then say(TEXT.failed:format(tostring(data))); return end
    say(TEXT.sending:format(names, #data.streets, #data.zones))
    TriggerLatentServerEvent('d11_mapnomes:save', 200000, json.encode(data))
end)

RegisterNetEvent('d11_mapnomes:saved', function(msg) say(msg) end)

-- Catalogo de acessorios do whip_gunny, lido do arquivo dele (items/attachments.lua) como o whip_d12_hud le os
-- pentes: as tabelas Config.Attachments / Config.WeaponAttachments nao sao exportadas. Armas de packs
-- (RegisterWeapon com `attachments`) nao aparecem aqui.

Catalog = { attachments = {}, weapons = {} }

function Catalog.load()
    local code = LoadResourceFile('whip_gunny', 'items/attachments.lua')
    local env = setmetatable({ Config = {} }, { __index = _G })
    local chunk = code and load(code, '@whip_gunny/items/attachments.lua', 't', env)
    if not (chunk and pcall(chunk)) then
        print('[d11_attachments] nao consegui ler whip_gunny/items/attachments.lua')
        return
    end
    Catalog.attachments = env.Config.Attachments or {}
    Catalog.weapons = env.Config.WeaponAttachments or {}
end

--- O componente GTA de um acessorio (item) nesta arma, ou nil.
function Catalog.component(weaponItem, attachmentItem)
    local att = Catalog.attachments[attachmentItem]
    local kinds = att and (Catalog.weapons[weaponItem] or {})[att.category]
    return kinds and kinds[att.tier] or nil, att
end

Catalog.load()
local function reload(name) if name == 'whip_gunny' then Catalog.load() end end
AddEventHandler(IsDuplicityVersion() and 'onResourceStart' or 'onClientResourceStart', reload)

-- Player status, 0-100 whole numbers, read from WHIP:
--   health ...... native: GTA kills at 100, so 200 = 100% and 100 = 0%
--   armour ...... native
--   hunger/thirst whip_core stats (GetStat); stress if some resource registers a 'stress' stat
--   energy ...... GTA's sprint stamina, or D11Hud.Stamina's export
--   oxygen ...... whip_core 'oxygen' stat, else GTA's time left under water
-- Shown like WHIP's own status HUD: logged in, alive and no screen open.

local POLL_MS = 200
local SHOW = D11Hud.Status ~= false   -- false: WHIP's own gauges stay, d11_hud draws none

local function pct(value)
    value = tonumber(value) or 0
    return math.floor(math.max(0, math.min(100, value)) + 0.5)
end

local function health(ped)
    local raw, max = GetEntityHealth(ped), GetEntityMaxHealth(ped)
    local floor = max > 100 and 100 or 0
    return pct((raw - floor) / math.max(1, max - floor) * 100)
end

local function customStamina()
    local source = D11Hud.Stamina
    if type(source) ~= 'table' or GetResourceState(source.resource or '') ~= 'started' then return nil end
    local ok, value = pcall(function() return exports[source.resource][source.export]() end)
    return ok and tonumber(value) or nil
end

local function readStatus()
    local ped, player = PlayerPedId(), PlayerId()
    return {
        health = health(ped),
        armor = pct(GetPedArmour(ped)),
        hunger = pct(Hud.core('GetStat', 'hunger') or 100),
        thirst = pct(Hud.core('GetStat', 'thirst') or 100),
        stress = pct(Hud.core('GetStat', 'stress') or 0),
        energy = pct(customStamina() or 100 - GetPlayerSprintStaminaRemaining(player)),
        oxygen = pct(Hud.core('GetStat', 'oxygen') or GetPlayerUnderwaterTimeRemaining(player) * 10),
    }
end

local function isActive()
    if Hud.core('IsPlayerLoaded') ~= true then return false end
    if Hud.core('IsPlayerDead') == true then return false end
    return Hud.core('IsAnyScreenOpen', true) ~= true
end

local function changed(a, b)
    if not b then return true end
    for key, value in pairs(a) do
        if b[key] ~= value then return true end
    end
    return false
end

CreateThread(function()
    local last
    while true do
        local active = isActive()
        if Hud.state.active ~= active then
            Hud.set('active', active)
            if not active then last = nil end
        end
        if active and SHOW then
            local status = readStatus()
            if changed(status, last) then
                last = status
                Hud.set('status', status)
            end
        end
        Wait(POLL_MS)
    end
end)

-- The speedometer, fed from WHIP:
--   fuel/charge .. whip_fuel's 'fuel' vehicle stat (GetVehicleStat), else GTA's
--   electric ..... whip_core IsVehicleElectric
--   rpm/gear ..... natives (GetVehicleCurrentRpm, the same reading as WHIP's own dial)
--   seatbelt ..... client/seatbelt.lua
--   turbo/nitro .. client/power.lua (whip_autos)
-- Only the driver sees it. Aircraft (classes 15/16) get heading, altitude, climb rate and the artificial horizon.

local L = D11Hud.L
local UPDATE_MS = 100
local LOCKED = { [2] = true, [3] = true, [4] = true, [7] = true, [10] = true }
local ROLL_SIGN = -1
local GEAR = { [0] = 'down', [1] = 'moving', [2] = 'moving', [3] = 'up' }
local KMH = D11Hud.SpeedUnit == 'kmh'
local yes = Hud.yes

local letters = {}
for d in L('N NE E SE S SW W NW', 'N NE L SE S SO O NO'):gmatch('%S+') do letters[#letters + 1] = d end

local function clamp01(value) return math.max(0.0, math.min(1.0, tonumber(value) or 0.0)) end

--- The compass letter for a heading in degrees (client/map.lua uses it too).
function Hud.direction(heading) return letters[math.floor(((heading % 360) + 22.5) / 45) % 8 + 1] end

local function readAircraft(vehicle, class)
    local rotation = GetEntityRotation(vehicle, 2)
    local gear
    if class == 16 and yes(DoesVehicleHaveLandingGear(vehicle)) then
        gear = GEAR[GetLandingGearState(vehicle)] or 'broken'
    end
    local heading = (360.0 - GetEntityHeading(vehicle)) % 360.0
    return {
        heli = class == 15,
        knots = GetEntitySpeed(vehicle) * 1.94384,
        altitude = GetEntityCoords(vehicle).z * 3.28084,
        agl = math.max(0, GetEntityHeightAboveGround(vehicle) * 3.28084),
        vs = GetEntityVelocity(vehicle).z * 196.85,
        heading = heading,
        direction = Hud.direction(heading),
        pitch = rotation.x,
        roll = rotation.y * ROLL_SIGN,
        gear = gear,
        rotor = class == 15 and clamp01(GetHeliMainRotorHealth(vehicle) / 1000) or nil,
        airborne = yes(IsEntityInAir(vehicle)),
    }
end

local function getGear(vehicle, electric)
    local gear = GetVehicleCurrentGear(vehicle)
    local text
    if gear > 0 then text = tostring(gear)
    else text = GetEntitySpeedVector(vehicle, true).y < -0.1 and 'R' or 'N' end
    if electric and text ~= 'R' and text ~= 'N' then return 'D' end
    return text
end

local function getFuel(vehicle)
    local fuel = tonumber(Hud.core('GetVehicleStat', { entity = vehicle }, 'fuel')) or GetVehicleFuelLevel(vehicle)
    return clamp01(fuel / 100)
end

local function readVehicle(vehicle)
    local class = GetVehicleClass(vehicle)
    local electric = Hud.core('IsVehicleElectric', vehicle) == true
    local _, lights, highbeams = GetVehicleLightsState(vehicle)
    local engineHealth = GetVehicleEngineHealth(vehicle)
    local running = yes(GetIsVehicleEngineRunning(vehicle))
    local aircraft = (class == 15 or class == 16) and readAircraft(vehicle, class) or nil
    return {
        visible = true,
        aircraft = aircraft,
        speed = GetEntitySpeed(vehicle) * (KMH and 3.6 or 2.237),
        unit = KMH and 'KM/H' or 'MPH',
        -- GetVehicleCurrentRpm: 0.2 at idle to 1.0 at the limiter (GetVehicleDashboardRpm answers 0 in this build)
        rpm = running and clamp01(GetVehicleCurrentRpm(vehicle)) or 0.0,
        gear = getGear(vehicle, electric),
        electric = electric,
        fuel = getFuel(vehicle),
        fuelVisible = class ~= 13,
        lights = yes(lights),
        highbeams = yes(highbeams),
        locked = LOCKED[GetVehicleDoorLockStatus(vehicle)] == true,
        engineVisible = class ~= 13,
        engineHealth = clamp01(engineHealth / 1000),
        engineRunning = running,
        checkEngine = engineHealth <= 300,
        seatbeltVisible = Hud.hasSeatbelt(vehicle),
        seatbelt = Hud.state.seatbelt == true,
    }
end

local function driving()
    if not Hud.state.active then return nil end
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    local vehicle = GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)
    if vehicle ~= 0 and GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, -1) == ped and yes(DoesEntityExist(vehicle)) then return vehicle end
end

CreateThread(function()
    local shown = false
    while true do
        local vehicle = driving()
        if vehicle then
            Hud.set('vehicle', readVehicle(vehicle))
            Hud.power(vehicle)
            shown = true
            Wait(UPDATE_MS)
        else
            if shown then
                Hud.set('vehicle', { visible = false })
                Hud.power(nil)
                shown = false
            end
            Wait(250)
        end
    end
end)

-- Estúdio de fotos do visual. O criador do whip_core abre (NUI open) e espera a resposta: a foto escolhida, ou
-- nada. Enquanto o estúdio está aberto esta página tem o foco; o criador continua aberto por baixo (câmera e
-- personagem são os dele) e se esconde sozinho.

local RES = GetCurrentResourceName()
-- Idioma: setr d11_locale en | pt-BR no server.cfg (padrao en), como os outros resources D11.
local LANG = GetConvar('d11_locale', 'en') == 'pt-BR' and 'pt-BR' or 'en'
local function L(en, pt) return LANG == 'pt-BR' and pt or en end
local aberto = false
local visualId = nil
local responder = nil      -- o callback do criador, respondido quando o estúdio fecha

-- As poses: as categorias da lista de emotes do WHIP que fazem sentido numa foto.
local CATEGORIAS = {
    { key = 'poses', label = L('Standing', 'Paradas') },
    { key = 'gestures', label = L('Gestures', 'Gestos') },
    { key = 'dance', label = L('Dances', 'Danças') },
}
local FORA = { 'sex' }   -- rótulos que não entram (poses sexuais)

local listaPoses = nil
local function poses()
    if listaPoses then return listaPoses end
    local por, out = {}, {}
    for _, c in ipairs(CATEGORIAS) do
        local cat = { key = c.key, label = c.label, poses = {} }
        por[c.key] = cat
        out[#out + 1] = cat
    end
    for _, e in ipairs((EmoteList or {}).emotes or {}) do
        local cat = por[e.category]
        local rotulo = tostring(e.label or e.cmd)
        local ok = cat and (e.dict or e.scenario)
        for _, f in ipairs(FORA) do if ok and rotulo:lower():find(f, 1, true) then ok = false end end
        if ok then cat.poses[#cat.poses + 1] = { cmd = e.cmd, label = rotulo, video = e.video } end
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(out) do table.sort(c.poses, function(a, b) return a.label < b.label end) end
    listaPoses = out
    return out
end

-- ============================================
-- O estúdio fica na SubUrban (Config.Ponto), numa dimensão só do player; ele volta para onde estava no fim.
-- ============================================
local origem = nil   -- { coords, heading, travado }
local indo = false   -- a ida ao estúdio ainda está acontecendo (a volta espera ela acabar)

local function esperarFade(saindo)
    local limite = GetGameTimer() + 1500
    while (saindo and not IsScreenFadedOut() or not saindo and not IsScreenFadedIn()) and GetGameTimer() < limite do Wait(0) end
end

local function levarPara(ped, x, y, z, h)
    RequestCollisionAtCoord(x, y, z)
    SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(ped, x, y, z, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(ped, h)
    local limite = GetGameTimer() + 4000
    while (not HasCollisionLoadedAroundEntity(ped)) and GetGameTimer() < limite do
        RequestCollisionAtCoord(x, y, z)
        Wait(0)
    end
end

local function irAoEstudio()
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    origem = { coords = GetEntityCoords(ped), heading = GetEntityHeading(ped), travado = IsEntityPositionFrozen(ped) }
    DoScreenFadeOut(300)
    esperarFade(true)
    TriggerServerEvent('d11_photostudio:entrar')
    local p = Config.Ponto
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, false)
    levarPara(ped, p.x, p.y, p.z, p.w)
    -- O interior da loja: espera ele aparecer (as lojas do jogo já estão no mapa, só precisam carregar).
    local limite = GetGameTimer() + 3000
    while GetInteriorFromEntity(ped) == 0 and GetGameTimer() < limite do Wait(0) end
    local interior = GetInteriorFromEntity(ped)
    if interior ~= 0 then
        PinInteriorInMemory(interior)
        while not IsInteriorReady(interior) and GetGameTimer() < limite do Wait(0) end
    end
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, true)
    Wait(250)
    DoScreenFadeIn(400)
end

local function voltarDoEstudio()
    local o = origem
    origem = nil
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    DoScreenFadeOut(300)
    esperarFade(true)
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, false)
    if o then levarPara(ped, o.coords.x, o.coords.y, o.coords.z, o.heading) end
    TriggerServerEvent('d11_photostudio:sair')
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, o and o.travado or false)
    Wait(250)
    DoScreenFadeIn(400)
end

-- A câmera do criador, pelo export do whip_core (patch creator-photostudio): a página do estúdio não alcança os
-- callbacks da página do whip_core. lock, stage, preset, yaw, turn, pan, orbitX, zoom.
-- Declarada ANTES de fechar() e do 'open', que a usam: um `local function` só existe da linha dele para baixo
-- (antes daqui era a global `camera`, nil: "attempt to call a nil value (global 'camera')").
local function camera(o) return pcall(function() return exports.whip_core:CreatorCamera(o) end) end

local function fechar(foto)
    if not aberto then return end
    aberto = false
    pcall(function() exports.whip_core:CancelEmote() end)
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'close' })
    local cb = responder
    responder, visualId = nil, nil
    camera({ lock = false })   -- a câmera volta a seguir o personagem
    -- O criador só volta depois que o player voltou para onde estava.
    CreateThread(function()
        while indo do Wait(0) end
        if origem then voltarDoEstudio() end
        if cb then cb({ ok = true, photo = foto }) end
    end)
end

-- O criador pede o estúdio para um visual salvo. Respondido só quando o estúdio fecha.
RegisterNUICallback('open', function(data, cb)
    local id = tonumber(data and data.id)
    if aberto or not id then cb({ ok = false }) return end
    aberto, visualId, responder = true, math.floor(id), cb
    local nome = type(data.name) == 'string' and data.name:sub(1, 40) or ''
    CreateThread(function()
        indo = true
        irAoEstudio()
        indo = false
        if not aberto then return end   -- fechou (morreu, deslogou) enquanto ia: o fechar já traz de volta
        SendNUIMessage({ action = 'open', name = nome, categories = poses(), lang = LANG })
        SetNuiFocus(true, true)
        -- O personagem no centro, a câmera travada no mundo (girar mexe só nele), o corpo inteiro com folga.
        camera({ stage = 0.0, lock = true, preset = 'body', yaw = 180.0 })
        SetTimeout(150, function() if aberto then camera({ zoom = 5 }) end end)
    end)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('camera', function(data, cb)
    if aberto and type(data) == 'table' then camera(data) end
    cb({ ok = true })
end)

-- Girar o personagem (a câmera fica travada no mundo: só ele gira na frente do fundo).
RegisterNUICallback('girar', function(data, cb)
    local g = tonumber(type(data) == 'table' and data.graus) or 0
    if aberto and g ~= 0 and g > -90 and g < 90 then
        local ped = PlayerPedId()
        SetEntityHeading(ped, (GetEntityHeading(ped) + g) % 360.0)
    end
    cb({ ok = true })
end)

-- R: de frente para a câmera de novo (a direção do ponto do estúdio).
RegisterNUICallback('frente', function(_, cb)
    if aberto then SetEntityHeading(PlayerPedId(), Config.Ponto.w + 0.0) end
    cb({ ok = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('pose', function(data, cb)
    local cmd = type(data) == 'table' and data.cmd
    local ok = false
    if type(cmd) == 'string' and cmd ~= '' then
        ok = pcall(function() exports.whip_core:PlayEmote(cmd) end)
    else
        ok = pcall(function() exports.whip_core:CancelEmote() end)
    end
    cb({ ok = ok })
end)

-- A foto da tela, só o jogo (sem nenhuma página). A página recorta a moldura.
RegisterNUICallback('shoot', function(_, cb)
    CreateThread(function()
        local img, why = exports.whip_core:TakeScreenshot({ format = 'png' })
        cb({ ok = type(img) == 'string', shot = img or nil, why = why })
    end)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('save', function(data, cb)
    local foto = type(data) == 'table' and data.photo
    if not aberto or type(foto) ~= 'string' or not foto:match('^data:image/webp;base64,') or #foto > 600000 then
        cb({ ok = false })
        return
    end
    TriggerLatentServerEvent('d11_photostudio:salvar', 400000, visualId, foto)
    cb({ ok = true })
    fechar(foto)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('close', function(_, cb)
    cb({ ok = true })
    fechar(nil)
end)

-- As fotos dos visuais, para os cartões do criador: { [id] = data URL }. O criador pergunta ao abrir.
local pedidos, proximo = {}, 0
RegisterNUICallback('photos', function(data, cb)
    local ids = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(type(data) == 'table' and type(data.ids) == 'table' and data.ids or {}) do
        local n = tonumber(v)
        if n and #ids < 50 then ids[#ids + 1] = math.floor(n) end
    end
    proximo = proximo + 1
    pedidos[proximo] = cb
    local meu = proximo
    TriggerServerEvent('d11_photostudio:pedir', meu, ids)
    SetTimeout(10000, function()
        if pedidos[meu] then pedidos[meu]({ photos = {} }); pedidos[meu] = nil end
    end)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('d11_photostudio:fotos', function(id, fotos)
    local cb = pedidos[id]
    pedidos[id] = nil
    if cb then cb({ photos = type(fotos) == 'table' and fotos or {} }) end
end)

-- Morreu, deslogou ou o resource parou com o estúdio aberto: fecha sem foto.
AddEventHandler('whip_core:player:died', function() fechar(nil) end)
AddEventHandler('whip_core:player:logout', function() fechar(nil) end)
AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(res)
    if res ~= RES or not aberto then return end
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    local o, ped = origem, PlayerPedId()
    if o then
        FreezeEntityPosition(ped, o.travado)
        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(ped, o.coords.x, o.coords.y, o.coords.z, false, false, false)
        SetEntityHeading(ped, o.heading)
        TriggerServerEvent('d11_photostudio:sair')
    end
    DoScreenFadeIn(0)
end)

-- A posição atual como vector4, para trocar Config.Ponto (só lê).
RegisterCommand(Config.ComandoPonto or 'fotospot', function()
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    local c, h = GetEntityCoords(ped), GetEntityHeading(ped)
    local txt = ('vector4(%.2f, %.2f, %.2f, %.1f)'):format(c.x, c.y, c.z, h)
    print('[d11_photostudio] Config.Ponto = ' .. txt)
    TriggerEvent('chat:addMessage', { args = { 'fotospot', txt } })
end, false)
