-- The weapon in hand and its ammo, read from whip_gunny:
--   rounds / capacity .. whip_gunny GetDrawnWeapon (ammo = rounds in the weapon, capacity = the magazine in it); with
--                        no magazine in, the first compatible magazine's size (0/12: an empty weapon)
--   spare (next to the
--   magazine icon) ..... magazine weapons: COMPATIBLE magazines with rounds in your pockets (metadata.ammo, the way
--                        gunny's reload picks one); weapons without one (revolver, shotgun): loose rounds of the calibre
--   without whip_gunny . GTA's own ammo
--   silhouette ......... ui/weapons/catalogue.json: the weapon plus the attachments really mounted on it; tools
--                        (camera, metal detector, shovel) while the prop is attached to the player
-- Read only: it never changes the weapon.

if D11Hud.Ammo == false then return end

local yes = Hud.yes
local UNARMED_HASH = `WEAPON_UNARMED`
local MELEE_GROUP = `GROUP_MELEE`

-- ---------- silhouettes ----------
local weapons, props = {}, {}
local catalogue = json.decode(LoadResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), 'ui/weapons/catalogue.json') or '{}') or {}
for name, entry in pairs(catalogue) do
    entry.folder = 'weapons/' .. name:lower() .. '/'
    entry.componentHashes = {}
    for variantName, variant in pairs(entry.variants) do
        if variantName ~= 'base' then entry.componentHashes[variantName] = joaat(variantName) end
        for _, group in ipairs(variant.groups) do
            for _, component in ipairs(group) do
                entry.componentHashes[component.component] = joaat(component.component)
            end
        end
    end
    if entry.propModel then props[joaat(entry.propModel)] = entry
    else weapons[joaat(name)] = entry end
end

local lastPed, lastHash, lastCheck, cachedKey, cachedLayers = nil, nil, 0, '', {}

local function weaponVisual(ped, hash)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if ped == lastPed and hash == lastHash and now >= lastCheck and now - lastCheck < 150 then
        return cachedKey, cachedLayers
    end
    lastPed, lastHash, lastCheck = ped, hash, now
    local entry = weapons[hash]
    local layers = {}
    if entry then
        local function equipped(name)
            return yes(HasPedGotWeaponComponent(ped, hash, entry.componentHashes[name]))
        end
        local variant = entry.variants.base
        for name, candidate in pairs(entry.variants) do
            if name ~= 'base' and equipped(name) then variant = candidate; break end
        end
        layers[1] = entry.folder .. variant.image
        for _, group in ipairs(variant.groups) do
            local selected, default
            for _, component in ipairs(group) do
                if component.default then
                    default = component
                elseif equipped(component.component) then
                    selected = component
                    break
                end
            end
            selected = selected or default
            if selected then layers[#layers + 1] = entry.folder .. selected.image end
        end
    end
    cachedLayers, cachedKey = layers, table.concat(layers, '|')
    return cachedKey, cachedLayers
end

local toolPed, toolCheck, toolEntity, toolEntry = nil, 0, nil, nil
local function heldToolVisual(ped)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if ped ~= toolPed or now < toolCheck or now - toolCheck >= 500 then
        toolPed, toolCheck, toolEntity, toolEntry = ped, now, nil, nil
        for _, entity in ipairs(GetGamePool('CObject')) do
            local entry = props[GetEntityModel(entity)]
            if entry and yes(IsEntityAttachedToEntity(entity, ped)) then
                if not toolEntry or entry.folder > toolEntry.folder then
                    toolEntity, toolEntry = entity, entry
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if toolEntity and yes(DoesEntityExist(toolEntity)) and yes(IsEntityAttachedToEntity(toolEntity, ped))
        and props[GetEntityModel(toolEntity)] == toolEntry then
        local path = toolEntry.folder .. toolEntry.variants.base.image
        return path, { path }
    end
    return '', {}
end

-- ---------- ammo ----------
-- whip_gunny's catalogue, read from its own files (Config.Weapons/Magazines/Calibers in items/*.lua): which magazines
-- each weapon takes, their size and each calibre's round item. gunny's exports only say what is in your hand.
local gunny = { weapons = {}, magazines = {}, calibers = {} }
local function loadGunnyCatalogue()
    if GetResourceState('whip_gunny') ~= 'started' then return end
    local env = setmetatable({ Config = {} }, { __index = _G })
    for _, file in ipairs({ 'items/calibers.lua', 'items/magazines.lua', 'items/weapons.lua' }) do
        local code = LoadResourceFile('whip_gunny', file)
        local chunk = code and load(code, '@whip_gunny/' .. file, 't', env)
        if chunk then pcall(chunk) end
    end
    gunny.weapons = env.Config.Weapons or {}
    gunny.magazines = env.Config.Magazines or {}
    gunny.calibers = env.Config.Calibers or {}
end
loadGunnyCatalogue()
AddEventHandler('onClientResourceStart', function(name) if name == 'whip_gunny' then loadGunnyCatalogue() end end)

local function gunnyWeapon()
    if GetResourceState('whip_gunny') ~= 'started' then return nil end
    local ok, w = pcall(function() return exports.whip_gunny:GetDrawnWeapon() end)
    return ok and type(w) == 'table' and w or nil
end

--- What you carry (pockets and the accessory strip), a list of { item, amount, metadata }.
local function carried()
    local inv = Hud.core('GetInventory')
    local list = {}
    for _, container in ipairs({ 'player', 'accessory' }) do
        for _, data in pairs(type(inv) == 'table' and inv[container] or {}) do list[#list + 1] = data end
    end
    return list
end

--- Spare: compatible magazines with rounds (magazine weapons) or loose rounds of the calibre (weapons without one).
--- Read at most every 500 ms (the loop runs at 50 ms and GetInventory copies the whole inventory).
local reserveCache = { item = nil, at = 0, value = 0 }
local function gunnyReserve(cfg, item)
    if not cfg then return 0 end
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if reserveCache.item == item and now - reserveCache.at < 500 then return reserveCache.value end
    reserveCache.item, reserveCache.at = item, now
    reserveCache.value = 0
    if cfg.magless then
        local caliber = gunny.calibers[cfg.caliber]
        reserveCache.value = caliber and tonumber(Hud.core('GetItemCount', caliber.ammoItem)) or 0
        return reserveCache.value
    end
    local takes = {}
    for _, mag in ipairs(cfg.compatibleMags or {}) do takes[mag] = true end
    local mags = 0
    for _, data in ipairs(carried()) do
        local ammo = type(data.metadata) == 'table' and tonumber(data.metadata.ammo) or 0
        if takes[data.item] and ammo > 0 then mags = mags + (tonumber(data.amount) or 1) end
    end
    reserveCache.value = mags
    return mags
end

local function readAmmo(ped, hash)
    local w = gunnyWeapon()
    if w and w.kind == 'gun' and (tonumber(w.capacity) or gunny.weapons[w.item]) then
        local cfg = gunny.weapons[w.item]
        local max = tonumber(w.capacity)
        if not max and cfg then   -- a magazine weapon with no magazine in: the first compatible one's size
            max = cfg.magless and tonumber(cfg.internalCapacity)
                or (cfg.compatibleMags and gunny.magazines[cfg.compatibleMags[1]] and tonumber(gunny.magazines[cfg.compatibleMags[1]].capacity))
        end
        max = math.floor(max or 0)
        local clip = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(w.ammo) or 0))
        if max > 0 then clip = math.min(clip, max) end
        return clip, max, gunnyReserve(cfg, w.item)
    end
    local hasClip, nativeClip = GetAmmoInClip(ped, hash)
    local clip = yes(hasClip) and nativeClip or 0
    local max = GetMaxAmmoInClip(ped, hash, true) or 0
    local reserve = math.max(0, (GetAmmoInPedWeapon(ped, hash) or 0) - clip)
    local spare = max > 0 and math.floor(reserve / max) or 0
    return math.floor(clip), math.floor(math.max(0, max)), spare
end

CreateThread(function()
    local visible, lastWeapon, lastClip, lastMax, lastSpare, lastKey, lastInVehicle = false, nil, -1, -1, -1, nil, nil
    while true do
        local ped = PlayerPedId()
        local inVehicle = yes(IsPedInAnyVehicle(ped, false))
        local gotWeapon, hash = GetCurrentPedWeapon(ped, true)
        local hasWeapon = yes(gotWeapon)
        local armed = hasWeapon and hash ~= UNARMED_HASH
        local melee = armed and GetWeapontypeGroup(hash) == MELEE_GROUP

        local show, clip, max, spare = false, 0, 0, 0
        if armed and not melee then
            clip, max, spare = readAmmo(ped, hash)
            show = true
        end

        local key, layers = weaponVisual(ped, armed and hash or UNARMED_HASH)
        if not armed and not yes(IsEntityDead(ped)) then
            key, layers = heldToolVisual(ped)
            melee = key ~= ''
        end
        if melee then show = key ~= '' end
        if not Hud.state.active then show = false end

        if show ~= visible or hash ~= lastWeapon or clip ~= lastClip or max ~= lastMax or spare ~= lastSpare
            or key ~= lastKey or inVehicle ~= lastInVehicle then
            visible, lastWeapon, lastClip, lastMax, lastSpare, lastKey, lastInVehicle = show, hash, clip, max, spare, key, inVehicle
            Hud.set('ammo', {
                visible = show,
                inVehicle = inVehicle,
                showAmmo = not melee,
                clip = clip,
                max = max,
                spare = spare,
                visualKey = key,
                layers = layers,   -- always: the snapshot (page reloaded) needs the layers
            })
        end
        Wait(show and 50 or 150)
    end
end)

-- d11_mapnomes: /d11mapnomes (ace command.d11mapnomes, e.g. group.admin) asks an admin in game to read the names and
-- saves them in labels.js, which the pause map reads. Only takes the data from the player it asked.

local PT = GetConvar('d11_locale', 'en') == 'pt-BR'
local TEXT = PT and {
    console = 'rode em jogo (precisa de um cliente para ler o mapa)',
    bad = 'Nomes do mapa: dados inválidos',
    fail = 'Nomes do mapa: não consegui gravar labels.js',
    saved = 'Nomes do mapa salvos (%d rótulos, %d bairros). Rode "restart d11_mapnomes" no console para mandar aos jogadores.',
} or {
    console = 'run it in game (it needs a client to read the map)',
    bad = 'Map names: invalid data',
    fail = 'Map names: could not write labels.js',
    saved = 'Map names saved (%d labels, %d districts). Run "restart d11_mapnomes" in the console to send them to players.',
}

local pending = {}

RegisterCommand('d11mapnomes', function(src)
    if src == 0 then print('[d11_mapnomes] ' .. TEXT.console); return end
    pending[src] = true
    TriggerClientEvent('d11_mapnomes:collect', src)
end, true)

local function list(t, n, check)
    if type(t) ~= 'table' then return false end
    for _, row in ipairs(t) do
        if type(row) ~= 'table' or #row ~= n or not check(row) then return false end
    end
    return true
end

RegisterNetEvent('d11_mapnomes:save', function(payload)
    local src = source
    if not pending[src] then return end
    pending[src] = nil
    local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, payload)
    local num = function(row) for i = 2, #row do if type(row[i]) ~= 'number' then return false end end return true end
    if not ok or type(data) ~= 'table' or data.v ~= 2
        or not list(data.streets, 5, function(r) return type(r[1]) == 'number' and num(r) end)
        or not list(data.zones, 4, function(r) return type(r[1]) == 'string' and #r[1] <= 16 and num(r) end) then
        TriggerClientEvent('d11_mapnomes:saved', src, TEXT.bad)
        return
    end
    -- labels.js is what the map reads (by <script>: CORS blocks a fetch between resources).
    local saved = SaveResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), 'labels.js',
        'globalThis.D11_MAP_LABELS = ' .. json.encode(data) .. ';\n', -1)
    local msg = saved and TEXT.saved:format(#data.streets, #data.zones) or TEXT.fail
    print(('[d11_mapnomes] %s (%s)'):format(msg, GetPlayerName(src) or src))
    TriggerClientEvent('d11_mapnomes:saved', src, msg)
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function() pending[source] = nil end)

-- Registra as bolsas (config.lua) como itens-painel do whip_core: abrir pelo menu ou duplo clique mostra um painel
-- ao lado do inventario (renderer d11_inventory). O conteudo vive no metadata `slots` do item, entao a bolsa
-- largada, guardada ou entregue leva tudo junto, e o whip_core soma o conteudo no peso de quem carrega.

local weightOf

--- Peso de uma pilha com o que houver dentro (bolsas, carteira e duffle guardam em metadata.slots).
weightOf = function(item, amount, metadata, depth)
    local def = exports.whip_core:GetItemDef(item)
    local total = ((def and def.weight) or 0) * (amount or 1)
    depth = (depth or 0) + 1
    local inner = depth <= 4 and type(metadata) == 'table' and metadata.slots
    if type(inner) == 'table' then
        for _, e in pairs(inner) do
            if type(e) == 'table' and e.item then total = total + weightOf(e.item, e.amount, e.metadata, depth) end
        end
    end
    return total
end

local function contentsWeight(host)
    local slots = host and type(host.metadata) == 'table' and host.metadata.slots
    local total = 0
    if type(slots) == 'table' then
        for _, e in pairs(slots) do
            if type(e) == 'table' and e.item then total = total + weightOf(e.item, e.amount, e.metadata) end
        end
    end
    return total
end

--- Limite interno da bolsa. Uma troca (swap) desconta o que sai do slot.
local function validator(bag)
    return function(ctx)
        if ctx.direction ~= 'in' or not ctx.item then return true end
        local now = contentsWeight(ctx.host)
        local adding = weightOf(ctx.item, ctx.amount, ctx.metadata)
        local r = ctx.replacing
        if ctx.swap and not r then   -- metade de volta de uma troca: quem esta no slot sai
            local slots = type(ctx.host.metadata) == 'table' and ctx.host.metadata.slots or {}
            r = slots[ctx.slot] or slots[tostring(ctx.slot)]
        end
        if type(r) == 'table' and r.item then now = now - weightOf(r.item, r.amount, r.metadata) end
        if now + adding > bag.maxWeight + 0.0001 then
            return false, D11BagsText.tooHeavy:format(bag.name, bag.maxWeight)
        end
        return true
    end
end

Whip.register(function()
    local n, failed = 0, {}
    for key, bag in pairs(D11Bags) do
        local ok, why = Whip.core:RegisterItem(key, {
            name = bag.name, desc = bag.desc, weight = bag.weight,
            type = 'accessory', stack = false, maxStack = 1, usable = false, cooldown = 0,
            -- sem o arquivo, o icone padrao do WHIP (o pacote publico nao traz os icones das caixas)
            image = LoadResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), ('html/img/items/%s.png'):format(key))
                and ('html/img/items/%s.png'):format(key) or nil,
            prop = bag.prop,
            defaultAction = D11BagsAction,
            contextOptions = { { action = D11BagsAction, label = D11BagsText.open } },
        })
        if ok then
            ok, why = Whip.core:RegisterPanelItem(key, {
                action = D11BagsAction, slots = bag.slots, label = bag.name, storageKey = 'slots',
                onValidate = validator(bag),
            })
        end
        if ok then n = n + 1 else failed[#failed + 1] = ('%s (%s)'):format(key, tostring(why)) end
    end
    print(('[d11_bags] %d bags registered%s'):format(n, #failed > 0 and ('; failed: ' .. table.concat(failed, ', ')) or ''))
end)

-- Municao e pentes (whip_gunny), dois atalhos sobre o carregar nativo do gunny (server/magazines.lua: a barra, a
-- animacao e as balas sao do servidor dele):
--   * arrastar a municao ate um pente compativel carrega o pente: o renderer pergunta aqui que municao cada pente
--     leva (gunnyInfo) e roda a opcao nativa do pente ('whip_gunny:load_mag', o "Carregar" do menu);
--   * carregar todos (/pentes, tecla em Configuracoes > Atalhos > FiveM, ou "Carregar todos os pentes" no menu da
--     arma): com a arma na mao, um pente compativel por vez, cada um com a sua barra. Cancelar: o cancelar da barra
--     (X, correr) ou /pentes de novo.
-- Sem patch no whip_gunny: o que cada pente leva vem das definicoes dos itens (calibre no cartao) e dos arquivos de
-- dados do gunny (items/calibers.lua, items/weapons.lua), lidos como dados.

local STR = {
    en = {
        noWeapon = 'Hold a gun to load its magazines.',
        none     = 'No magazine to load for this gun.',
        noAmmo   = 'No ammo for these magazines.',
        stopping = 'Stopping after this magazine.',
        done     = 'Magazines loaded: %d (%d rounds).',
        stopped  = 'Loading stopped: %d magazines (%d rounds).',
        keyLabel = 'Load all magazines (gun in hand)',
    },
    ['pt-BR'] = {
        noWeapon = 'Saque uma arma para carregar os pentes dela.',
        none     = 'Nenhum pente para carregar dessa arma.',
        noAmmo   = 'Sem munição para esses pentes.',
        stopping = 'Para depois deste pente.',
        done     = 'Pentes carregados: %d (%d balas).',
        stopped  = 'Carregamento parado: %d pentes (%d balas).',
        keyLabel = 'Carregar todos os pentes (arma na mão)',
    },
}
local function L(key)
    local t = STR[GetConvar('d11_locale', 'en')] or STR.en
    return t[key] or STR.en[key]
end
local function notify(text, kind) pcall(function() exports.whip_core:Notify(text, kind or 'info') end) end

--- Uma tabela de dados do whip_gunny (Config.<key> de um arquivo so de dados), ou {}.
local cache = {}
local function gunnyData(file, key)
    if cache[file] then return cache[file] end
    local src = LoadResourceFile('whip_gunny', file)
    local env = { Config = {} }
    local fn = src and load(src, '@whip_gunny/' .. file, 't', env)
    cache[file] = (fn and pcall(fn) and env.Config[key]) or {}
    return cache[file]
end
AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(res) if res == 'whip_gunny' then cache = {} end end)

local function defs()
    local ok, d = pcall(function() return exports.whip_core:GetItemDefs() end)
    return ok and type(d) == 'table' and d or {}
end

--- O calibre do cartao de um item do gunny (arma ou pente), ou nil.
local function caliberOf(def)
    for _, row in ipairs(type(def) == 'table' and def.metaFields or {}) do
        if row.key == 'caliber' then return row.value end
    end
end

local function isMag(def) return type(def) == 'table' and def.defaultAction == 'whip_gunny:load_mag' end

--- [pente] = item da municao que ele leva (pentes de packs incluidos: vem das definicoes).
local function ammoOfMags()
    local calibers, out = gunnyData('items/calibers.lua', 'Calibers'), {}
    for item, def in pairs(defs()) do
        if isMag(def) then
            local c = calibers[caliberOf(def) or '']
            if c and c.ammoItem then out[item] = c.ammoItem end
        end
    end
    return out
end

RegisterNUICallback('gunnyInfo', function(_, cb)
    cb({ ammoOf = ammoOfMags() })
end)

-- ---- carregar todos ----

local running, cancel = false, false
local ASK_BASE = 1500000000   -- longe dos pedidos do proprio gunny (1, 2, 3...), que ele ignora por nao conhecer
local askSeq, asks = 0, {}

RegisterNetEvent('whip_gunny:client:loadDone', function(ask, ok, result)
    local p = asks[ask]
    if not p then return end
    asks[ask] = nil
    p:resolve({ ok == true, result })
end)

--- Carrega o pente no endereco pelo caminho nativo do gunny e espera o fim da barra.
local function loadOne(slot, pocket)
    askSeq = askSeq + 1
    local ask, p = ASK_BASE + askSeq, promise.new()
    asks[ask] = p
    TriggerServerEvent('whip_gunny:server:loadMagazine', { sub = pocket, slot = slot }, ask)
    SetTimeout(120000, function() if asks[ask] then asks[ask] = nil; p:resolve({ false, 'timeout' }) end end)
    local r = Citizen.Await(p)
    return r[1], r[2]
end

--- Os pentes da arma na mao ainda com espaco, nos bolsos e na faixa: { slot, pocket, ammoItem }.
local function magsFor(weapon)
    local all, ammoOf = defs(), ammoOfMags()
    local fits = {}
    local w = gunnyData('items/weapons.lua', 'Weapons')[weapon.item]
    if w and type(w.compatibleMags) == 'table' then
        for _, m in ipairs(w.compatibleMags) do fits[m] = true end
    else   -- arma de pack (fora do arquivo): o mesmo calibre
        local cal = caliberOf(all[weapon.item])
        for item, def in pairs(all) do if isMag(def) and cal and caliberOf(def) == cal then fits[item] = true end end
    end
    local mags = gunnyData('items/magazines.lua', 'Magazines')
    local ok, inv = pcall(function() return exports.whip_core:GetInventory() end)
    local list = {}
    for _, pocket in ipairs({ 'player', 'accessory' }) do
        for slot, d in pairs(ok and type(inv) == 'table' and inv[pocket] or {}) do
            if fits[d.item] and ammoOf[d.item] then
                local cap = tonumber(exports.whip_core:GetItemSetting(d.item, 'capacity'))
                    or (mags[d.item] and tonumber(mags[d.item].capacity)) or math.huge
                local has = type(d.metadata) == 'table' and tonumber(d.metadata.ammo) or 0
                if has < cap then
                    list[#list + 1] = { slot = math.tointeger(tonumber(slot)), pocket = pocket, ammoItem = ammoOf[d.item] }
                end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(list, function(a, b)
        if a.pocket ~= b.pocket then return a.pocket == 'player' end
        return a.slot < b.slot
    end)
    return list
end

local function loadAll()
    if running then
        cancel = true
        notify(L('stopping'))
        return
    end
    local okW, weapon = pcall(function() return exports.whip_gunny:GetDrawnWeapon() end)
    if not okW or type(weapon) ~= 'table' or weapon.kind ~= 'gun' then return notify(L('noWeapon'), 'error') end
    local list = magsFor(weapon)
    if #list == 0 then return notify(L('none'), 'error') end

    running, cancel = true, false
    CreateThread(function()
        -- o inventario fica aberto: a barra do gunny pede keepInventory (whip_core-progress-keep-inventory-d11.patch)
        local mags, rounds, stopped = 0, 0, false
        for _, m in ipairs(list) do
            if cancel then stopped = true break end
            if (exports.whip_core:GetItemCount(m.ammoItem) or 0) < 1 then
                if mags == 0 then notify(L('noAmmo'), 'error') end
                break
            end
            local ok, res = loadOne(m.slot, m.pocket)
            if ok then
                mags, rounds = mags + 1, rounds + (tonumber(res) or 0)
            elseif res == 'Loading cancelled' or res == 'Busy' or res == 'timeout' then
                stopped = true
                break
            end
            Wait(250)   -- a arma volta a mao entre um pente e outro (whip_gunny:client:magLoading)
        end
        if mags > 0 then notify((stopped and L('stopped') or L('done')):format(mags, rounds), stopped and 'info' or 'success') end
        running, cancel = false, false
    end)
end

RegisterCommand('pentes', loadAll, false)
RegisterKeyMapping('pentes', L('keyLabel'), 'keyboard', '')
exports('LoadAllMagazines', loadAll)

RegisterNUICallback('loadAllMags', function(_, cb)
    cb({ ok = true })
    loadAll()
end)

-- As fotos dos visuais, uma por visual de cada personagem: photos/<personagem>_<visual>.txt (o data URL webp).
local RES = GetCurrentResourceName()
local MAX = 600000

local function personagem(src)
    local ok, id = pcall(function() return exports.whip_core:GetCharId(src) end)
    if not ok or id == nil then return nil end
    id = tostring(id):gsub('[^%w_-]', '')
    return id ~= '' and id or nil
end

local function arquivo(char, visual) return ('photos/%s_%d.txt'):format(char, visual) end

local function idValido(v) return type(v) == 'number' and v == math.floor(v) and v >= 0 and v <= 99999999 end

RegisterNetEvent('d11_photostudio:salvar', function(visual, foto)
    local src = source
    local char = personagem(src)
    if not char or not idValido(visual) then return end
    if type(foto) ~= 'string' or #foto > MAX or not foto:match('^data:image/webp;base64,[%w%+/=]+$') then
        print(('[d11_photostudio] photo refused from %s (format or size)'):format(src))
        return
    end
    if not SaveResourceFile(RES, arquivo(char, visual), foto, -1) then
        print(('[d11_photostudio] could not save %s (does the photos folder exist?)'):format(arquivo(char, visual)))
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('d11_photostudio:pedir', function(pedido, ids)
    local src = source
    local char = personagem(src)
    local fotos = {}
    if char and type(ids) == 'table' then
        for i, v in ipairs(ids) do
            if i > 50 then break end
            if idValido(v) then
                local foto = LoadResourceFile(RES, arquivo(char, v))
                if foto and foto ~= '' then fotos[tostring(v)] = foto end
            end
        end
    end
    TriggerLatentClientEvent('d11_photostudio:fotos', src, 400000, pedido, fotos)
end)

-- ============================================
-- A dimensão do estúdio
-- ============================================
-- Enquanto fotografa, o player fica numa dimensão só dele (Config.DimensaoBase + id). Para isso não virar um
-- jeito de andar invisível pela cidade, quem se afastar do ponto do estúdio volta para a dimensão de antes.
local voltar = {}   -- [src] = a dimensão de antes
local LONGE = 30.0

local function sair(src)
    local b = voltar[src]
    if b == nil then return end
    voltar[src] = nil
    SetPlayerRoutingBucket(src, b)
end

RegisterNetEvent('d11_photostudio:entrar', function()
    local src = source
    if voltar[src] ~= nil then return end
    voltar[src] = GetPlayerRoutingBucket(src)
    local b = Config.DimensaoBase + src
    SetRoutingBucketPopulationEnabled(b, false)
    SetPlayerRoutingBucket(src, b)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('d11_photostudio:sair', function() sair(source) end)
AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function() voltar[source] = nil end)

CreateThread(function()
    local p = Config.Ponto
    local ponto = vector3(p.x, p.y, p.z)
    while true do
        Wait(5000)
        for src in pairs(voltar) do
            local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
            if ped == 0 or #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - ponto) > LONGE then
                print(('[d11_photostudio] %s walked away from the studio: back to their own routing bucket'):format(src))
                sair(src)
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Arrastar ate o personagem de verdade para usar/equipar, sem o anel do whip_core (core/inv-body.js): o alvo e o corpo
-- inteiro na tela e, com o item em cima, o proprio personagem ganha um contorno na cor do tema. O renderer pergunta
-- (bodyBox) onde o corpo esta na tela enquanto arrasta e avisa (bodyHot) quando o item entra e sai dele.

local BONES = { 31086, 14201, 52301, 45509, 40269, 18905, 57005, 11816 }   -- cabeca, pes, bracos, maos, pelve
local ACCENT = { 0, 156, 228, 255 }                                        -- --accent do style.css (#009CE4)

local function yes(value) return value == true or value == 1 end
local outlined = 0   -- o ped com contorno agora (0: nenhum)

local function outline(on)
    local ped = on and PlayerPedId() or outlined
    if ped == 0 then return end
    if on then SetEntityDrawOutlineColor(ACCENT[1], ACCENT[2], ACCENT[3], ACCENT[4]) end
    SetEntityDrawOutline(ped, on)
    outlined = on and ped or 0
end

--- O retangulo do corpo na tela (0 a 1), ou nil (primeira pessoa, fora da tela).
local function box()
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    if not IsPedInAnyVehicle(ped, false) and GetFollowPedCamViewMode() == 4 then return nil end
    local x0, y0, x1, y1, seen = 1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0
    for _, bone in ipairs(BONES) do
        local c = GetPedBoneCoords(ped, bone, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
        local ok, x, y = GetScreenCoordFromWorldCoord(c.x, c.y, c.z)
        if yes(ok) then
            seen = seen + 1
            x0, y0, x1, y1 = math.min(x0, x), math.min(y0, y), math.max(x1, x), math.max(y1, y)
        end
    end
    if seen < 3 then return nil end
    -- folga: os ossos ficam por dentro da silhueta (cabeca, ombros, pes)
    local w, h = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
    local padX = math.max(w * 0.25, 0.012)
    return { x0 = x0 - padX, y0 = y0 - h * 0.08, x1 = x1 + padX, y1 = y1 + h * 0.03 }
end

-- off: o gesto esta desligado agora (config.lua ou um bloqueio): sem alvo no corpo nem na ficha
RegisterNUICallback('bodyBox', function(_, cb)
    if not D11Gestures.allowed('body') then return cb({ hidden = true, off = true }) end
    cb(box() or { hidden = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('bodyHot', function(data, cb)
    outline(type(data) == 'table' and data.on == true)
    cb({ ok = true })
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(res)
    if res == GetCurrentResourceName() and outlined ~= 0 then SetEntityDrawOutline(outlined, false) end
end)

-- The WHIP layer (whip/hud.css: rev dial hidden, round minimap; whip/status.css: WHIP's gauges hidden, voice as a
-- circle) goes into whip_core's page as a WHIP theme, but only when no other theme is active. With your own theme,
-- @import the files from it (README) and set D11Hud.WhipLayer = false. Stopping d11_hud puts WHIP's look back.
--
-- What happened is always said: one line in this console, and the same line in each player's F8 (client/layer.lua
-- reads GlobalState.d11_hud_layer), since that is where people look first.

local SELF = GetCurrentResourceName()
local IMPORT = ("@import url('https://cfx-nui-%s/whip/hud.css'); @import url('https://cfx-nui-%s/whip/status.css');")
    :format(SELF, SELF)

--- theme: the WHIP theme that carries the layer (d11_hud itself or d11_theme); the client hands whip_core's page that
--- one again if it missed it, never d11_hud over another theme.
local function report(on, text, theme)
    -- every public whip_core (1.0.0 on) draws its minimap in its own page (#minimap3d), which whip/hud.css rounds
    text = ('%s (whip_core %s)'):format(text, GetResourceMetadata('whip_core', 'version', 0) or '?')
    GlobalState.d11_hud_layer = { on = on, text = text, resource = SELF, theme = on and (theme or SELF) or nil }
    print(('%s[d11_hud] %s^0'):format(on and '^2' or '^3', text))
end

-- The layer itself: hud.css, and status.css unless D11Hud.Status = false (WHIP's own gauges stay then).
local function layerCss()
    local out = { "/* d11_hud's layer inside WHIP's page. Written by d11_hud when it starts, emptied when it stops: do not edit. */" }
    out[#out + 1] = LoadResourceFile(SELF, 'whip/hud.css') or ''
    if D11Hud.Status ~= false then out[#out + 1] = LoadResourceFile(SELF, 'whip/status.css') or '' end
    return table.concat(out, '\n')
end
exports('WhipLayerCss', layerCss)   -- d11_theme 1.1.0+ asks for it and keeps it in its own css/d11_hud.css

-- d11_hud as its own WHIP theme (theme.css): whip/status-layer.css follows D11Hud.Status, no line to delete.
SaveResourceFile(SELF, 'whip/status-layer.css', D11Hud.Status ~= false and (LoadResourceFile(SELF, 'whip/status.css') or '')
    or '/* D11Hud.Status = false: WHIP\'s own status gauges stay. */\n', -1)

-- d11_theme 1.1.0+ imports its own css/d11_hud.css, written from WhipLayerCss as it starts (FiveM hands players a
-- resource's files as they were when it started). When what it serves is not our layer (it started before us, or
-- Status changed), or when we stop, it is restarted so it writes the right one: nobody edits theme.css.
local THEME_RES, THEME_LAYER = 'd11_theme', 'css/d11_hud.css'
local function themeTakesLayer()
    return GetResourceState(THEME_RES) == 'started'
        and (LoadResourceFile(THEME_RES, 'theme.css') or ''):find(THEME_LAYER, 1, true) ~= nil
end
local function restartTheme(why)
    print(('^3[d11_hud] restarting d11_theme: %s^0'):format(why))
    StopResource(THEME_RES)
    StartResource(THEME_RES)
end

-- Stopping: the theme goes back to an empty layer, or WHIP's gauges would stay hidden with no HUD of ours.
AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(res)
    if res ~= SELF or not themeTakesLayer() then return end
    if (LoadResourceFile(THEME_RES, THEME_LAYER) or ''):find('#minimap3d', 1, true) then restartTheme('d11_hud stopped') end
end)

if D11Hud.WhipLayer == false then
    report(false, ('WHIP layer off: WhipLayer = false in config.lua. Your WHIP theme must carry %s'):format(IMPORT))
    return
end

-- Inside Whip.register so it is set again after a whip_core restart.
Whip.register(function()
    local theme, owner = exports.whip_core:GetActiveTheme()
    if theme == SELF then
        report(true, 'WHIP layer on: d11_hud is already WHIP\'s active theme.')
        return
    end
    if themeTakesLayer() then
        if (LoadResourceFile(THEME_RES, THEME_LAYER) or '') ~= layerCss() then
            restartTheme('it started before d11_hud (or Status changed), so it serves an old layer')
        end
        report(true, 'WHIP layer on: carried by d11_theme (its css/d11_hud.css).', THEME_RES)
        return
    end
    if theme == 'd11_theme' then
        -- d11_theme 1.0.x: the two @import lines ship commented out (a failed import drops the whole theme)
        local css = LoadResourceFile('d11_theme', 'theme.css') or ''
        if ("\n" .. css):find("\n@import url%('https://cfx%-nui%-" .. SELF .. "/whip/hud%.css") then
            report(true, 'WHIP layer on: through d11_theme, which imports whip/hud.css and whip/status.css.', 'd11_theme')
        else
            report(false, ('WHIP layer off: d11_theme 1.0.x is the active WHIP theme. Update it to 1.1.0 (github.com/DLady25/whip-d11-theme), which takes the layer by itself, or add %s to its theme.css.')
                :format(IMPORT))
        end
        return
    end
    if theme == 'whip_theme_d12' then
        report(false, ('WHIP layer: "whip_theme_d12" is the active WHIP theme; the copy in the old D11 Starter Kit does not round the minimap. Replace it with d11_theme (github.com/DLady25/whip-d11-theme), which carries the layer, or add %s to its theme.css right after its own @import lines.')
            :format(IMPORT))
        return
    end
    if theme ~= nil and theme ~= '' and theme ~= false then
        report(false, ('WHIP layer off: the WHIP theme "%s" is active (%s), so d11_hud cannot load its own. Add %s to that theme\'s theme.css, or WHIP\'s gauges and square minimap stay on screen.')
            :format(tostring(theme), owner and ('set by ' .. tostring(owner)) or 'Config.Theme', IMPORT))
        return
    end
    local ok, err = exports.whip_core:SetActiveTheme(SELF)
    if not ok then
        report(false, ('WHIP layer off: whip_core refused it (%s).'):format(tostring(err)))
        return
    end
    report(true, 'WHIP layer on: d11_hud set itself as WHIP\'s active theme (whip/hud.css, whip/status.css).')
end)

-- Sent again after login: whip_core sends the theme at login, but FiveM's NUI can serve the theme.css cached from the
-- last session; sending it again swaps the <link> and the page fetches it anew.
AddEventHandler('whip_core:player:loaded', function(data)
    local src = type(data) == 'table' and tonumber(data.source)
    if not src then return end
    SetTimeout(2000, function()
        if GetPlayerName(src) and exports.whip_core:GetActiveTheme() == SELF then
            TriggerClientEvent('whip_core:client:applyTheme', src, SELF)
        end
    end)
end)
